jobs.title: Engineering Project Coordinator (Water/Wastewater)
jobs.description:
Full-Time

Fountain Valley, CA

Competitive Salary

Apply to hr@pacewater.com

#### **Description**

We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, notices the details, anticipates what needs to happen next and enjoys helping a team stay organized. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between multiple projects and priorities and takes pride in producing polished, accurate work. You don’t need to know every PACE system on your first day—we value strong project coordination skills, initiative, professionalism and the ability to learn.

  

PACE is seeking a dynamic, highly organized individual with strong administrative skills to support administrative needs specifically for our Environmental Water Division. The admin group works as a team, so at times, is not limited to this one division. This candidate should be able to multi-task and have ability to switch to new projects accordingly. This position requires performing a variety of tasks, including, but not limited to the following:

**Requirements:**

* Coordinate the preparation, formatting, production and submittal of engineering reports, technical memoranda, specifications, proposals and other project deliverables.

* Prepare and format professional correspondence, proposals, change orders, purchase orders, sub-agreements, RFIs, work authorizations, meeting minutes, reports, tables and spreadsheets.

* Assist Project Managers with project schedules, tracking, monthly reports, invoicing and other project administration.

* Coordinate project documentation from project startup through completion, including electronic project files and correspondence.

* Assist with engineering specifications, including formatting and maintenance of specification libraries.

* Coordinate contracts and other project documentation to help ensure timely processing.

* Assist with project-related purchasing, shipping and vendor coordination.

* Prepare presentations and other project or marketing materials as needed.

* Coordinate meetings, calendars, travel arrangements and expense reports for Division Managers and senior staff.

* Attend meetings, prepare professional meeting minutes and track follow-up items.

* Maintain client and project information within company databases.

* Work collaboratively with PACE’s administrative, engineering and graphics teams.

* Provide additional project and administrative support as priorities arise.

* 3+ years of project coordination, project administration or administrative experience.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and changing priorities.

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, professional work.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint.

* Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a team.

* Professional judgment and ability to handle confidential information.

**Highly Preferred**

* + Experience within a civil engineering, environmental consulting, architecture, construction, or other A/E/C professional-services environment.
  + Experience supporting engineers, project managers or technical professionals.
  + Experience preparing technical reports, specifications, proposals or similar professional project documents.
  + Experience with Deltek, Ajera, Procore or comparable project management/ERP software.
  + Experience with Microsoft Project.

#### **Physical Demand**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands, handle or feel; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk and reach with hands and arms. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision; color vision is very helpful.

#### **Work Environment**

The noise level in the office work environment is moderate and typical of a professional office environment.

#### **Salary Range**

Competitive salary commensurate with experience and capabilities, $30–$38 per hour.

*PACE is an equal opportunity employer.*
  
*At this time, PACE will not sponsor a new applicant for work authorization.*
  
*Local candidates are preferred. No relocation package is offered.*

If interested, please respond to this posting by submitting your resume with salary requirement to: hr@pacewater.com.

  

NO RECRUITERS PLEASE.

jobs.title: Graduate Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
This position will provide a broad range of high-level administrative services for School of Communication PhD and MS programs. Working with the Graduate Program Director, Dean, Asst Deans, faculty and staff, plan, coordinate and oversee day-to-day program operational activities. Perform other duties as assigned.  
  
Chapman University’s mission is centered on serving our students and strengthening our campus community. Chapman believes there is significant value in an in-person workforce. Being present fosters collaboration, strengthens relationships across departments, enables us to better serve our co-workers and contributes to the student experience. It is an important part of the culture that makes Chapman a special place to work and learn.

Responsibilities

* Coordinate and provide administrative assistance to the School of Communication graduate programs, faculty, and students
* Work collaboratively with the Graduate Program Director, Asst Deans, and Undergraduate Program Coordinator in development of class schedules, taking faculty load into account; input and maintain class schedules. Collaborate with Graduate Director/Chair on semester course scheduling and assist with graduate student registration process and orientation
* Assist the Graduate Program Director with student enrollment, Assigning Advisors in PeopleSoft, and Permission Numbers.
* Assist the Graduate Program Director with graduate student registration process and orientation
* Work collaboratively with faculty in reviewing, editing, and processing graduate course and catalog changes annually.
* Assist Faculty and Undergraduate Program Coordinator with hiring, and managing on-boarding, of new full-time and part-time faculty
* Generate graduate faculty contracts
* Coordinate with SMC for graduate program advertising
* Manage purchasing, ordering and reimbursements for Graduate program specific needs
* Coordinate room needs for Graduate program faculty and staff
* Serve as liaison with the Office of Graduate Admissions and the Office of Graduate Education
* Manage the hiring process for SOC graduate students (GShip); generate GSI (Graduate Student Instructor) contracts and GRA (Grad Research Assistant) paperwork, interfacing with VPGE (Vice Provost for Graduate Education) and HR as necessary and troubleshooting any problems
* Work collaboratively with the Graduate Director/Chair and faculty to manage graduate student thesis projects, completion of forms, faculty committee members, thesis defenses, degree completion protocols
* Assist with MS and PhD admission process and recruiting (Tracking admissions applications, coordinating information sessions, and communicating with applicants and potential applicants.)
* Review SOC graduate student scholarly and creative activity, grant awards, routing student applications to appropriate faculty and assuring timely review submission
* Assist MS and PhD students with travel for university business needs
* Manage payments, reimbursements, etc. for Grad faculty and students
* Disseminate program information and respond to inquiries from prospective students
* Work with current graduate students to answer program-related questions and concerns
* Serve as college staff rep for the university-wide events for graduate students
* As a member of the college staff team, assist with college-wide and department activities
* Serve as backup to other support positions as needed
* Some travel and weekend work hours are required.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination in education and experience.
* 2-3 years of related working experience
* Demonstrated effective oral and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills
* Proven ability to exercise independent thinking and judgment to carry out duties in a timely manner.
* Ability to exercise initiative and work independently and as a team member.
* Experience in providing administrative support in a professional office.
* Demonstrated ability to use tact and diplomacy and to maintain a high level of confidentiality.
* Proven ability to prioritize duties when faced with interruptions, distractions, and fluctuating workload.
* Proficient knowledge and skill in Microsoft Office Suite applications.
* Ability to learn in-house software

Desired Qualifications

* Master’s degree in related field.
* Experience in admission and recruiting.
* Working knowledge of university software, policies, and procedures

Special Instructions to Applicants

At Chapman University, we believe collaboration thrives through in-person engagement. This position is fully on campus, and employees work alongside colleagues, faculty, students, and staff each day to support our vibrant university community.

Chapman University is an equal opportunity employer that provides equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of their protected characteristics. All qualified applicants and employees are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by state or federal law.

Applicants for Staff and Administrator positions must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

The offer of employment is contingent upon satisfactory completion and outcomes of a criminal background screening and returning to the Office of Human Resources a signed original acceptance of the Chapman University Agreement to Arbitrate.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
SUMMARY  
The Senior Marketing Coordinator develops messages for print and digital forms of marketing, and copyedits content written by self and other members of the Marketing Department team. The incumbent handles daily administrative approval items in customer relationship management (CRM) and timekeeping platforms, and supports marketing campaign/project enhancements and communications for the Marketing department.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.  

* Write messages through various content types including print collateral, website content, brochures, publications, product descriptions, press releases, announcements, and other forms of marketing.
* Copyedit content written by self and team members for spelling, grammar, syntax, and punctuation to ensure accuracy and brand consistency. Work closely with designers and marketing team members to update and amend written content according to feedback.
* Conduct research, monitor marketing trends and support competitive marketing campaigns.
* Maintain marketing database and photo library, and filing systems for paper and electronic documents.
* Fulfill administrative tasks such as sample order entry, and maintaining marketing documents and resource materials related marketing and communication activities.
* Handles daily administrative approval items in Salesforce CRM platform (e.g., sample order entry, Co-op credit, purchase requisitions, check requests, trip reports, IRAs), and timekeeping platform.
* Provide marketing project and tradeshow support.
* Provide customer service and sales support as needed.
* Exercise judgment to balance priorities and communicate to teams to meet and exceed project deadlines and commitments; keep the marketing team informed of projects and progress.
* Assist with special projects and other job-related duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES  
This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE  
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Journalism, Communications, or Public Relations AND 3 years of related experience, OR equivalent combination of education, training and experience.  
Prior experience in corporate content creation, Social Media, and other creative content development is a plus.

COMPUTER SKILLS  
Possess intermediate knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook) and proficiency with PC and Mac platforms and tools. Basic knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator) is a plus, but not necessary.

LANGUAGE SKILLS  
Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of the organization. The ability to present ideas effectively using both oral and written skills. Ability to communicate effectively with customers, vendors, and co-workers.  
Ability to write clearly and with good logic, and ensure content has correct punctuation, grammar, and syntax.

REASONING ABILITY  
Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Abilities to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, verbal, diagram, or schedule form.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  
While performing duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to handle, or feel, and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit. The employee is occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and rarely lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT  
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  
The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator, RN
jobs.description:
The START Center for Cancer Research (“START”) is the world’s largest early phase site network, fully dedicated to oncology clinical research. To date, over 45 therapies conducted at START locations have obtained FDA/EMA approval.

The START Center for Cancer Research is seeking a **Clinical Research Coordinator, RN.** The Clinical Research Coordinator, RN will work under the guidance of senior research staff to support the daily activities of early phase oncology clinical trials. The CRC, RN ensures the accurate and timely conduct of clinical research, adhering to protocols, regulatory requirements, and patient safety standards. This role involves direct patient interaction, data collection, and maintaining compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP). The Clinical Research Coordinator will be assigned multiple protocols at any time for which they will oversee the aspects of assigned protocols with planning and coordinating patient participation in the trial. Also, this role is responsible for implementation as well as completion of protocol specific requirements, providing accurate, up to date information to all team members involved with any aspect of carrying out protocol specific requirements.

The hourly pay rate for this role is **$45/hour-$65/hour**. However, base pay may vary depending on multiple individualized factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

**Work Schedule:** Monday-Friday 8:00am-5:00pm

  

**Location:** START Los Angeles - 10700 Santa Monica, Suite 310 Los Angeles, California 90025

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Communicate on a regular basis with Study Sponsor’s, CRO’s, staff, etc. regarding questions, concerns, as well as status of the protocol.

* Monitor the overall day-to-day conduct of assigned studies in accordance with the specified protocol requirements, Standard Operating Procedures, and Good Clinical Practice to ensure integrity regarding all aspects of the study.

* Create/review forms created or revised for assigned trials to assure protocol compliance.

* Maintain files using standardized study document labeling and filing procedures.

* Implement initial protocol and amendments, training staff who will be involved in patient treatment and management.

* Maintain an up-to-date contact list.

* Assist with patient screening and determination of eligibility.

* Facilitate the informed consent process ensuring that consent is appropriately completed.

* Prepare and manage source documents according to standard operating procedures.

* Recognize deviations to the protocol and will work with leadership and staff to address corrective actions to prevent deviations.

* Assist data coordinator team with case report form completion and query resolution.

* Work with the Principal Investigator to complete and submit Serious Adverse Event reports.

* Perform protocol specific closeout related activities in conjunction with the data coordinator.

* Provide documentation for all deviations whether related to the protocol or a SOP.

* Ensure that all team members involved understand and adhere to assigned protocols.

* Perform telephone triage assessments of patients on trial when necessary.
* Provide patient education regarding participation in a clinical trial, chemotherapy/biotherapy/investigational agent administration and potential side effects.

  

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Associate’s degree in Nursing.

* RN license in state practicing.

* 2 years of clinical research experience.

* Basic understanding of oncology clinical trials, particularly Phase 1 studies

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data collection and documentation

* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

* Excellent organizational and time-management skills

* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

* Ability to interact professionally with patients, study staff, and external stakeholders

* Working knowledge of GCP and regulatory requirements

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and clinical trial management software

  

**Preferred Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Nursing.

* Experience working in an oncology setting.

  

**Physical & Travel Requirements:**

* Approximately 80% of time is spent sitting.

* Very fast-paced and ever-changing healthcare environment.

* Demanding deadlines and time frames.

* Constant demand for updating knowledge.

* Works closely with physicians and ancillary personnel in caring for and treating oncology/hematology patients.

  

**Best-in-Class Benefits and Perks**

We value our employees’ time and efforts. Our commitment to your success is enhanced by a competitive compensation, depending on experience, and an extensive benefits package including:

* Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance provided
* Robust retirement planning: 401(k) plan available with employer matching
* Financial security: Life and disability insurance for added protection
* Flexible financial options: Health savings and flexible spending accounts offered
* Well-being and work-life balance: Paid time off, flexible schedule, and remote work choices provided
* Plus, we work to maintain the best environment for our employees, where people can learn and grow with the company. We strive to provide a collaborative, creative environment where everyone feels encouraged to contribute to our processes, decisions, planning, and culture.

jobs.title: Clinical Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Support the systems that help deliver quality care.**

U.S.VETS is seeking a **Clinical Administrative Coordinator** to support the administrative, clinical documentation, training, reporting, and compliance functions of our Behavioral Health department. Reporting to the Director of Behavioral Health, this role helps ensure clinical teams have the systems, documentation, training, and resources needed to deliver effective services and meet organizational and funder requirements.

This is an ideal opportunity for an organized, detail-oriented professional who is comfortable coordinating across teams, managing deadlines, reviewing documentation, and supporting clinical quality and compliance.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Coordinate annual training schedules and ensure clinical and program staff complete required training and competency assessments.
* Develop and maintain internal and external reporting calendars and coordinate timely submission of required reports.
* Monitor program deliverables and work with leadership to address gaps and corrective actions.
* Conduct regular client file and clinical documentation audits to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* Partner with case management and clinical staff to resolve documentation deficiencies and maintain audit-ready records.
* Coordinate admission and discharge processes to support efficient workflows and a positive client experience.
* Support external funder and accreditation audits, serving as a key site contact and coordinating with Operations, Finance, and other departments.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* 2+ years of experience coordinating clinical services, clinical administration, program operations, or administrative oversight in a clinical setting.
* Strong organizational, time-management, and attention-to-detail skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines, work independently, and collaborate across teams.
* Experience with documentation compliance, audits, reporting, or quality assurance preferred.
* Experience working with veterans or behavioral health populations preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, electronic case records, client tracking systems, and other information systems.
* Valid driver’s license may be required based on program needs; must meet company insurance requirements and complete required driver training.

jobs.title: Bilingual People Operations Coordinator

**Location:**

* **California Food Factory:** 1850 Raymer Ave, Fullerton, CA, 92283 (N. Gilbert St and W. Commonwealth Ave.) | Monday to Friday (Weekends - rarely occasional)

This role serves as a key resource for employees and managers by delivering timely support, maintaining accurate records, and helping ensure compliance with company policies and employment regulations within a fast-paced ready-to-eat food manufacturing environment.

* Coordinate pre-employment screenings and onboarding requirements.
* Coordinate new hire onboarding activities, including orientation scheduling, new hire paperwork, and employment eligibility verification (Form I-9).
* Ensure employee files and onboarding documentation are completed and maintained accurately.
* Assist with employee events, communications, and engagement activities.
* Assist with employee separations, exit documentation, and offboarding processes.
* Serve as a point of contact for employee questions regarding policies, benefits, payroll, and general employment matters.
* Escalate complex employee relations concerns to the People Operations Manager.
* Maintain employee files and documentation in accordance with company policies and applicable federal, state, and local requirements.
* Assist with HR audits, compliance tracking, and required reporting.
* Support compliance with California labor laws, food manufacturing requirements, and company policies.
* Coordinate employee training programs, including food safety, workplace safety, harassment prevention, and other required compliance trainings as well tracking and maintaining training records.
* Assist in scheduling and organizing development and learning opportunities.
* Partner with staffing agencies to coordinate onboarding requirements, attendance tracking, and compliance documentation for temporary employees.
* Work with corporate providing information to be recorded within HRIS and related systems.
* Generate routine reports and assist with data audits to ensure accuracy.
* Process employee status changes, promotions, transfers, and other personnel actions.
* Assist with communicating company policies, procedures, and People Operations programs.
* Support policy acknowledgment tracking and document retention requirements.
* Coordinate leave-related documentation and employee communications.
* Maintain leave records and assist with tracking leaves of absence under the direction of the People Operations Manager.
* Ensure required documentation is collected and filed appropriately.
* Support workplace safety initiatives and training programs.
* Assist with workers' compensation reporting, documentation, and claim tracking.
* Partner with Operations and Safety teams to maintain accurate records and follow-up documentation.
* Participate in People Operations projects and initiatives as assigned.
* May travel occasionally to support People Operations initiatives and training activities at other company locations.

**Qualifications:**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish is required
* 1-3 years of Human Resources, administrative, recruiting, or employee support experience highly preferred.
* Experience in manufacturing, food production, distribution, or a related environment preferred.
* Working knowledge of California employment laws and HR best practices preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

jobs.title: Inventory & Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Surgical Republic | On-site — Southern California**

**About the role:**

Surgical Republic supplies surgical instruments, disposables and implants to hospitals and surgery centers. We are seeking an organized, reliable Inventory & Purchasing Coordinator to manage supplier orders and move products accurately from receiving through customer delivery.

You will order from approved U.S. and international suppliers, maintain inventory records, pack and ship orders, and follow up on delays. Our customer-service team handles instrument cross-referencing and provides the approved product specifications and part numbers.

**Responsibilities:**

Purchasing and supplier follow-up

* Place purchase orders using approved suppliers, part numbers, quantities and spending limits.
* Confirm pricing, pack sizes, availability and delivery dates before ordering.
* Track open supplier orders and follow up on backorders or delayed shipments.
* Coordinate international shipment documentation with suppliers and freight/customs contacts.
* Flag unexpected freight charges, tariffs, price increases and delivery risks.
* Route substitutions or unclear product details to customer service for approval.
* Send supplier invoices and payment requests to the financial controller.

Inventory and receiving

* Receive deliveries and verify products, quantities and condition against purchase orders.
* Record receipts, stock movements and storage locations accurately.
* Maintain an organized, clearly labeled inventory area.
* Conduct regular cycle counts and investigate discrepancies.
* Monitor approved stock levels and submit replenishment needs.
* Track trial/demo instruments, returns and outstanding loaned inventory.

Order fulfillment

* Pick, check and pack the correct products and quantities.
* Prepare packing slips, shipping labels and required documents.
* Schedule carrier pickups and record tracking information.
* Coordinate partial shipments and backorders with customer service.
* Process approved returns and report damaged or incorrect items.

Order tracking and communication

* Keep the shared order tracker current, including supplier confirmations, delivery dates, blockers and shipment status.
* Notify customer service promptly when an order’s promised date is at risk.
* Maintain purchase orders, invoices and shipping records so each transaction can be traced.
* Log incoming customer checks and hand them to the authorized person for deposit.

**How you will work with the team:**

* Hassan, Customer Service: Provides cross-referenced products and approved part numbers; handles customer communication.
* Angelina, Financial Controller: Handles supplier payments, customer collections and financial reconciliation.
* Sales team: Provides approved trial requests and upcoming customer requirements.
* Sam, Owner: Approves spending exceptions, new suppliers and unusual purchasing commitments.

You will not independently select equivalent instruments, change approved specifications, set customer pricing or authorize supplier payments.

**Qualifications:**

* Experience in inventory coordination, purchasing, warehouse operations or order fulfillment.
* Strong attention to part numbers, quantities, pack sizes and documentation.
* Comfortable using spreadsheets, inventory systems and shipping software.
* Reliable supplier follow-up and clear written communication.
* Ability to manage multiple open orders and flag problems early.
* Ability to perform the physical receiving, packing and shipping duties, with reasonable accommodation.

Medical-device or surgical-instrument distribution experience is preferred. Experience with international purchasing, QuickBooks, Shopify or Fishbowl is helpful.

**What success looks like:**

* Accurate inventory records and organized stock.
* Correct, complete customer shipments.
* Supplier orders placed within approved costs and quantities.
* Delays identified and communicated promptly.
* Clear tracking of every open order and trial return.
* Routine orders completed with minimal management intervention.

Pay: $22.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Event Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
**The Miles Lawrence Company**  
**Part-Time | On-Call / Event-Based**  
**$20–$25 per hour**  
**Orange County & Greater Los Angeles Area**

**About The Miles Lawrence Company**

The Miles Lawrence Company is a growing hospitality, events, media, and lifestyle company built around creating memorable experiences and community-centered brands.

Our portfolio includes Tipsy Toucan Private Bartending, Shoreline Food Catering, The Cotton Candy Co., Streetlights Play, Lucky Lizard Landscaping, La Mirada Blog, and other developing concepts.

From private parties and corporate events to community gatherings and our own in-house experiences, our team believes the smallest details can make the biggest difference.

As we continue to grow, we're building a team of energetic, dependable people who enjoy events, hospitality, creativity, and working behind the scenes to bring experiences to life.

**The Role**

We're looking for **Event Operations Assistants** to join our growing event team.

This is a flexible, part-time, and event-based position that is especially well suited for college students, young professionals, or anyone looking for supplemental weekend work and hands-on experience in events, hospitality, and small business operations.

You'll essentially be an extra set of capable hands wherever they're needed.

No two events will look exactly the same. One weekend you may help transform a backyard for a private event. Another weekend you might assist our bartending, catering, children's entertainment, or activation teams at a client event.

We're looking for people who can take direction, move quickly, stay positive, and aren't afraid to jump in and help.

**What You'll Do**

Responsibilities may include:

* Assisting with event setup and breakdown
* Loading and unloading event equipment and supplies
* Setting up tables, chairs, décor, bars, signage, lighting, and event activations
* Helping prepare Miles Lawrence Company events and client events
* Restocking supplies throughout events
* Keeping event spaces organized and guest-ready
* Supporting bartending, catering, entertainment, and activation teams as needed
* Assisting with cleanup and packing equipment after events
* Running supplies or completing small event-related errands
* Helping solve unexpected problems during an event
* Working alongside event leads to ensure events run smoothly
* Representing the Miles Lawrence Company professionally around clients and guests

This is a **hands-on position**. You should be comfortable moving equipment, being on your feet, working both indoors and outdoors, and helping wherever the team needs you.

**Who We're Looking For**

You may be a great fit if you are:

* Dependable and punctual
* Friendly and professional
* Comfortable taking direction
* Able to work independently after receiving instructions
* Detail-oriented
* Flexible when plans change
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced event environment
* Willing to do both the fun and not-so-glamorous parts of event production
* Comfortable interacting with clients, vendors, guests, and other team members
* Interested in hospitality, events, entrepreneurship, marketing, production, or small business

**Previous event experience is not required.**

We're more interested in finding people with a strong work ethic, good attitude, and willingness to learn.

**Schedule**

There are **no guaranteed weekly hours**. Team members will be offered available event shifts and may accept shifts based on their availability.

This makes the position particularly suitable for students and people looking for flexible supplemental work.

Event shifts may range from approximately 4–10 hours depending on the event.

**Physical Requirements**

Because this is an event operations role, applicants should be able to:

* Remain on their feet for extended periods
* Frequently bend, lift, carry, and move event equipment
* Safely lift approximately 40–50 lbs
* Work outdoors when necessary
* Work occasional late nights and weekends

**Compensation**

**$20–$25/hour**, depending on experience and level of responsibility.

There will also be opportunities for team members who consistently perform well to take on greater responsibility within our growing group of companies.

**Why Join Us?**

This isn't a traditional desk job.

You'll get exposure to multiple growing businesses and learn firsthand what goes into producing events, running hospitality companies, developing brands, and creating memorable experiences.

For someone interested in entrepreneurship, events, hospitality, marketing, or business, you'll have the opportunity to see a growing company from the inside.

As our companies grow, we want our best people to grow with us.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction telling us:

* A little about yourself
* Your current school, job, or primary commitment
* Why this position interests you
* Your availability
* Any relevant event, hospitality, customer service, leadership, or team experience

We value **attitude, reliability, and initiative** just as much as previous experience.

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Procurement Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**  
Pulp Studio Inc. is a leading manufacturer of fine architectural glass products, dedicated to delivering high-quality solutions that enhance modern spaces. We pride ourselves on innovation, craftsmanship, and excellence in every project we undertake.

**Job Overview**  
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Procurement Coordinator to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for sourcing and purchasing materials essential for our manufacturing processes, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to quality standards. Your expertise will help maintain smooth production workflows and uphold our commitment to superior product quality.

**Duties**

* Creates POS with supporting documents (ex. Packing slips, payment info), issues, tracks, and follows up on purchase orders to ensure materials are ordered and delivered on time.
* Communicates with vendors regarding pricing, availability, lead times, order status, quality issues, and delivery schedules.
* Monitors inventory levels and assists with identifying when materials need to be reordered.
* Tracks material availability and communicates potential shortages or delays to the appropriate teams.
* Coordinates incoming material deliveries and verifies quantities and documentation upon receipt.
* Develops and maintains positive working relationships with suppliers and vendors.
* Requests and compares vendor quotes and assists with identifying cost-effective purchasing options.
* Works closely with Production, Inside Sales, and Project Management to understand current and upcoming material requirements.
* Maintains organized purchasing records, including purchase orders, packing slips, invoices, product information, and Safety Data Sheets (SDS).
* Assists with researching new materials, products, and suppliers when project or production material needs arise.
* Optimizes usage based on incoming orders with an emphasis in reducing obsolescence.
* Develops and maintains a buying/price database in the company’s ERP (PSIOPS) for every product.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in procurement, inventory, supply chain, manufacturing, or related field.
* Ability to handle materials safely according to safety standards in production
* Strong negotiation skills and attention to detail in materials handling and inventory management
* Ability to communicate clearly and professionally, both verbal and written.
* Customer service driven.
* Glass or construction related experience preferred.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.

*Pulp Studio, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against persons because of age, race, color, creed, religion, disability, gender, ethnic or national origin, or veteran status. Pulp Studio prohibits discrimination against individuals with disabilities and will reasonably accommodate applicants with a disability, upon request, and will also ensure reasonable accommodation to employees with a disability.*

Pay: $20.00 - $26.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance

jobs.description:
Citrin Cooperman offers a dynamic work environment, fostering professional growth and collaboration. We’re continuously seeking talented individuals who bring fresh perspectives, a problem-solving mindset, and sharp technical expertise. jobs.title: Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who we Are?**

Intersection is an experience-driven Out of Home media and technology company that delivers programming, consumer amenities, and advertising to cities. From free internet access to way-finding to real-time information, our products make city life easier and more sustainable. We further enrich cities with experiential programming that inspires and engages people throughout their day. With valuable, diverse audiences in America’s top cities, we provide innovative, data-driven solutions for brands to reach urbanites at scale.

**What is the Role?**

Intersection is seeking an upbeat, energetic, and self-motivated Sales Coordinator to join the Client Success Team and work in our local office. This is a fast-paced, detail-oriented, and varied role that is perfect for someone who has experience in sales support within the media/advertising world. The ideal candidate will have outstanding interpersonal and customer service skills, have a drive to learn and the ability to perform sales support responsibilities and thrive within a team environment. Above all, this individual will provide full support to their Sales Account Executive(s), improve the sales cycles by aiding to activate new processes to ensure we live by “The Intersection Way” - maintaining a collaborative and consultative effort with our Clients.

**What you will accomplish:**

**Within your first month:**

* You will build strong relationships with your Manager, the Account Executives and Account Manager that they support
* You will onboard/train with one of the Client Success Sales Ambassadors
* You will take a deep dive into learning Intersections media and advertising offerings
* You will be a Mentee to other Sales Coordinators to learn the process and systems used within the sales support organization
* You will be exposed to all departments within Intersection and experience how they are part of the sales cycle

**Within your first three-six months:**

* You will be able to support your Account Executives/Account Managers by generating and processing contracts, proposals, and presentations that enable Intersection to scale rapidly
* You will gain exposure and have daily communication with our Clients/Agencies
* You will manage all inventory requests, inventory holds, market avails, media plans / proposals for your Account Executives/Account Managers book of business
* You will generate targeting maps and visuals for RFP responses
* You will handle invoicing requests / billing inquiries
* You will own the pre-sale lifecycle of a contract: initial market research to contract creation and execution, to artwork / specification requests, track production process
* You will research and document competitive requests
* Develop a reputation for being a solid resource and will develop the foundational knowledge of our business model and the various media products and assets
* You will be a “go-to” person who gets stuff done accurately and on time, whether it’s printing materials, setting up meetings with our clients, or building sales decks from scratch
* You will be communicating over email / by phone with internal resources (charting, ad ops, inventory, & account teams) and our Clients to ensure a smooth & positive customer service experience
* You will be a member of a great team at Intersection!

**You're a great fit for this role because:**

* You have a degree from an Accredited Institution
* You have 1-2+ years relevant work experience in a customer-facing customer success, account management or strategic consulting organization
* You can multi-task a number of different items
* You enjoy collaborating with people to get work done, but know when to take ownership of a task
* You demonstrate a high level of accountability for both your work and the work of your team
* You have strong attention to detail and can spot and fix errors
* You work fast but thoughtfully, and make suggestions for efficiencies along the way
* You have knowledge of Adobe and Microsoft Office Suite and do not mind busy work utilizing these tools for RFPs

Total Cash compensation: $50,000 - $55,000

### **Hybrid Work Policy**

Our team operates on a hybrid schedule to balance flexibility with face-to-face collaboration. We require all employees to be in the office every Tuesday and Wednesday. Please note that starting in September, this requirement will transition to three days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday), with the flexibility to work remotely for the remainder of the week.

*At Intersection we celebrate every voice that makes us unique and every perspective that makes us grow. It’s our shared responsibility to create an equitable environment where every employee contributes to the culture of the company. Our products and offerings impact cities across the world and it’s our goal to represent the diversity and differences that make cities special. We will be relentless in that pursuit, because together we are better. **Account Executive, Public Relations (Financial Services)**
============================================================

Account Executives at Highwire are passionate communicators and collaborative team players who bring client programs to life. On our Financial Services team, they work with leading and emerging brands in financial services, banking, insurance technology, and other financial industries. They support media relations, content development, and client program execution that help clients stand out in complex markets. Account Executives are strong writers, proactive problem solvers, and eager learners who excel in media relations, client management, and strategic storytelling.

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

### **Client Service & Program Support**

* Support day-to-day contact for client teams and help manage project timelines and deliverables.
* Participate in client calls and contribute to status updates, coverage reports, and next-step planning.
* Support program execution across media relations, awards, speaking, and thought leadership campaigns.
Research industry trends, competitors, and breaking news to identify media or commentary opportunities.  

### **Media & Influencer Relations**

* Support media outreach efforts by building and maintaining journalist lists and researching new opportunities.
* Draft and send high-quality media pitches and press materials that align with client goals.
* Help monitor and report on media coverage and trends in business, finance, and financial services.
Assist in developing and managing clients' social media and amplification strategies, especially on LinkedIn.  

### **Writing & Content Development**

* Draft and edit PR materials, including press releases, pitches, blogs, bios, and award submissions.
* Translate complex business or financial topics into clear, engaging stories.
Ensure consistency in tone, quality, and key messaging across all written content.  

### **Insights & Reporting**

* Track and analyze media results, providing clear reports and takeaways for clients.
* Help identify ways to use analytics and media performance data to strengthen storytelling and outreach.
Collaborate with internal teams (content, design, digital) to ensure integrated program delivery.  

### **Team Collaboration & Growth**

* Work closely with senior team members to support strategy execution and learn best practices.
* Take initiative on projects, communicate progress clearly, and seek feedback regularly.
Contribute to a positive, collaborative team culture built on respect and accountability.  

**Success Factors:**
--------------------

* 2–3 years of PR or communications experience, in an agency environment
* Familiarity or interest in financial services, insurtech, or banking industries
* Strong writing and editing skills across a variety of formats
* A growing network of media contacts and enthusiasm for media relations
* Excellent organization and attention to detail
* A proactive, flexible, and collaborative attitude
* Familiarity with analytics and reporting tools (a plus)

  

*The salary range for this position is $54,000 to $72,000, with the final offer based on a combination of factors, including education, relevant experience, skills, prior training, internal equity, and local geographic market data. This role also includes a competitive benefits package with medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) matching, generous paid time off, and additional perks designed to support your overall well-being and growth.* *#LI-Remote*

jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

The Inside Account Management team is part of DoorDash's SMB account management engine.

We are dedicated to the retention, satisfaction, and growth of 8,500+ high-impact restaurant partners. From our hubs in Tempe and Chicago, our team ensures that our merchants understand how to maximize their visibility, optimize their operations, and thrive on DoorDash. We pride ourselves on being data-driven, collaborative, and deeply committed to championing small business success.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Merchant Success Manager (MSM), you will play a critical role in supporting and growing DoorDash's SMB restaurant partners. You will manage a focused book of approximately 75 merchants, building long‑term relationships and helping restaurant owners improve their performance on the platform. Through consistent outbound calls, email outreach, and data‑driven conversations, you will guide merchants on how to increase visibility, optimize their listings, adopt DoorDash products, and ultimately grow their revenue.

You'll be accountable for hitting weekly and quarterly KPIs — including high‑volume outbound activity (dials, talk time), strategic merchant calls, QBR delivery, and results tied to revenue, operational metrics, ads/promo adoption, and fair pricing conversations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys fast‑paced, high‑volume merchant engagement, uses data to drive decisions, and feels energized by work that blends sales, account management, and portfolio‑level strategy.

We expect this role to be flexible in terms of time spent remote and in-office with the ability to travel as needed for in-person collaboration through training, offsites, team-building events, and other business related necessity.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Make high‑volume outbound dials to existing merchants in your book of business (approximately 75 SMB restaurants), using a clear prioritization framework to decide where to focus your time and energy
* Establish goals and key performance indicators for your restaurant partners, and regularly review performance against those targets.
* Advise business owners on pricing, promotions, and product adoption (e.g., DashPass, Ads, promos) to achieve their revenue and margin goals, clearly explaining trade‑offs.
* Communicate with merchants by phone and email on an ongoing basis to monitor performance, surface risks, and proactively support progress toward their goals.
* Deliver and present quarterly business reviews ("QBR") that review a brand's partnership with DoorDash, pinpointing success, highlighting areas for revenue optimizations, and planning for areas of opportunity and growth
* Reduce churn, while identifying and supporting new store expansions
* Collaborate with internal growth teams to identify the best products to pitch to merchants
* Persist through slower periods or skeptical merchants — testing new approaches, refining talk tracks, and maintaining consistent activity even when results lag
* Ability to travel as needed for in-person collaboration through trainings, offsites, team-building events, and other business-related necessities

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* You have 2+ years of experience in client-facing sales roles, increasing customer satisfaction, retention, and product adoption
* You are comfortable being measured on both activity (dials, talk time, meetings) and outcomes (revenue, retention, product adoption) and can point to how you performed against your targets
* You have 2+ years of experience in Outbound Sales being held to DTT minimums
* You have 2+ years of experience in business operations or related setting
* You have experience in outbound sales and/or account management where you directly owned a book of accounts, managed prioritization, and were accountable for retention and growth
* You have experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools
* You are versed in using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel (can maintain complex spreadsheets), on an intermediate to proficient level
* You demonstrate empathy with customer needs and adapt to meet their unique goals
* You are goal‑oriented and competitive in a healthy way — you treat targets as a floor, not a ceiling, and enjoy going after stretch goals when you see an opportunity
* You bring strong AI fluency, or a clear eagerness to build it, and use new tools to improve efficiency, output, and impact—while knowing when human judgment and connection matter most.

  

Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only

We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound from August 21, 2023, through December 21, 2023, and resumed using Covey Scout for Inbound again on June 29, 2024.

The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: Covey

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're commit

RAM will execute a Go-To Market Strategy derived from prospecting and collaborating with SLED Focused Partners to build and maintain a constant revenue pipeline. * Create and maintain project documentation, including Project Charters, Change Orders, RFI/RFP materials, rollout documentation, and training guides.
* Maintain project information and team coordination through tools such as Jira, Asana, and Confluence.
* Identify opportunities to improve PMO processes, tools, and project delivery practices.

**Work Schedule and Benefits**

* Full-time position, Non-exempt, Hourly
* Office Hours in Irvine, CA: Monday-Friday, 8:00 am-5:00 pm
* Department needs will call for occasional overtime
* Excellent Benefits, to include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, FSA’s, 401(k)/Profit Sharing Plan, Adoption Assistance, Education Reimbursement, Supplemental Health Plans and Pet Insurance
* Pay Range: $32.00 - $35.50/hour
* *The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we'll consider your experience and other job-related factors.*

**Qualifications for In-N-Out Associates**

* 2+ years of In-N-Out Burger Store or Support experience required.
* Store leadership experience preferred, including experience as a Shift Manager, Store Trainer, All Star, or similar role.

**Qualifications**

* Previous or Current employment with In-N-Out Burger highly preferred.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 1+ year of experience in project coordination, project support, or equivalent experience.
* Working knowledge of project lifecycle concepts, including scope, timelines, resources, risks, and deliverables.
* Familiarity with Agile and/or Waterfall project management practices.
* Experience with or exposure to project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Asana, Confluence, and Microsoft Teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Strong organizational, time-management, communication, and customer service skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work collaboratively across teams, and adapt to changing project needs.
* Comfortable learning and working with new technology, systems, and processes.

**Work Location Details**

In-N-Out Burger plans to bring its west coast headquarters team back together under one roof by the end of 2029. After maintaining two Southern California office locations for many years, the company will permanently close its Irvine office in 2029 and once again headquarter the company’s western territory solely in Baldwin Park, California, where the company was founded in 1948.

Newly hired Associates in Irvine will be eligible to participate in the group move to Tennessee with relocation assistance or work from our western headquarters in Baldwin Park, CA, upon its opening in 2029. We are sharing this information early so candidates can make informed decisions while considering a career with In-N-Out Burger.

**About In-N-Out Burger**

In-N-Out Burger was founded in 1948 by Harry and Esther Snyder in Baldwin Park, California, and remains privately owned and operated. Under the direction of the Snyder family, the company has opened restaurants throughout California, Nevada, Arizona, Utah, Texas, Oregon, Colorado, Idaho, Washington, and Tennessee. In-N-Out Burger’s menu has remained the same since 1948, and we have maintained a simple philosophy – serve only the highest quality product, prepare it in a clean and sparkling environment, and serve it in a warm and friendly manner. We have built a reputation for fresh, made-to-order foods prepared and served by friendly, well trained Associates.

In-N-Out Burger offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefit package. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer by choice. Should there be a need, In-N-Out Burger will provide a reasonable accommodation to complete the interview process upon request.

**Klēn Earth Products**

**About Klēn Earth Products**

Klēn Earth Products is a growing personal care manufacturing company committed to building a strong organization, delivering exceptional products, and creating an environment where our team can succeed.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for an exceptional **Executive Assistant to the CEO & Executive Operations** who can serve as a trusted partner to our CEO and an important resource to our leadership team.

jobs.description:
3 Day Blinds is a national retailer and manufacturer of quality, custom-made blinds, shades, draperies, and shutters. We are proud to be part of the Hunter Douglas family of brands. Over the last 40 years we've successfully helped transform our clients' homes and workplaces by offering a wide variety of products that add beauty and comfort to every space. It takes a talented group of individuals to do what we do, and we do it together as One Team. We strive to create a culture of learning and opportunity, and most importantly, an environment where you can feel passionate and connected to your work every day.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. The Social Media Coordinator is responsible for developing and executing social media strategies that help 3 Day Blinds and SPF Screens & Awnings build brand awareness, increase appointments, and drive sales. * Grow content volume and quality, with an emphasis on video

* Continuously identify and propose social strategy optimizations to improve KPIs

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field a plus. Equivalent hands-on experience will be considered in place of a degree.

* Detail oriented with strong organizational habits
* Strong written communication and copywriting skills, with the ability to adapt tone across platforms

This role is pivotal in growing an assigned portfolio of customers, ensuring exceptional service, and driving sales of specialty branded merchandise, such as embroidered polo shirts, jackets, and other products. The ideal candidate will possess strong interpersonal skills, organizational abilities, and a proactive approach to building relationships with both existing and prospective customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Provide concierge-level customer service to ensure an exceptional experience.
* Respond to customer and internal queries promptly, aiming for a 24-hour turnaround time.
* Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude with customers and team members.
* Address and resolve customer complaints effectively and efficiently.
* Build and nurture long-term relationships with customers through open and proactive communication.

**Sales & Account Management**

* Drive growth and profitability for assigned accounts through upselling, cross-selling, and retention strategies.
* Identify and pursue new customer opportunities, leveraging leads within 24 hours of receipt.
* Develop and execute marketing and sales strategies to meet personal and team sales targets.
* Provide quotes and customized solutions to customers within field authority pricing guidelines.
* Foster collaboration with plant teams to maximize sales opportunities.

**Operational Support**

* Set up and maintain customer accounts, including online stores, pricing, and product options.
* Train customers on using online web stores and encourage adoption of automated systems.
* Process orders, modifications, and payments in a timely and accurate manner (within 24-48 hours).

* Create and manage artwork proofs, mock-ups, and custom designs for customer review and approval.

* Generate invoices and collect payments for orders.
* Follow up on past-due invoices and achieve monthly accounts receivable goals.
* Address and resolve billing inquiries professionally and efficiently.

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent; additional education is a plus.
* Proven customer service experience, with the ability to handle challenging situations calmly.
* Strong computer literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Office and other software.

**Preferred Skills**

* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Attention to detail and a focus on delivering quality.
* Experience with programs such as NetSuite, ABS, and supplier portals is a plus.
* Experience working in a spreadsheet environment (Microsoft Excel)

**Programs Used**

* ABS, Bi-Launch, Microsoft Office, NetSuite, Outlook, Penn Emblem Portal, Shipworks, Uniform Market/Seller’s Commerce, and other supplier portals.

* A dynamic work environment with a collaborative and supportive team culture.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Comprehensive training on our products, systems, and processes.

If you are a detail-oriented professional with a passion for customer service and sales, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Help us grow our direct sales channel while making a meaningful impact on our customers’ businesses.

* Exceptional Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off for vacation and sick time

* Paid Life Insurance

jobs.title: Client Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
***About Valligent***

Valligent, a Veros Software company, is a leading provider of technology-enabled real estate valuation solutions. The company delivers innovative appraisal, property inspection, and valuation services that help lenders, investors, and mortgage professionals make faster, more informed decisions while improving accuracy, compliance, and the borrower experience. Founded in 2003, Valligent combines industry expertise with advanced technology to modernize the property valuation process.

***Job Summary***

Valligent is looking for a Client Relationship Manager to help strengthen relationships with existing clients, support new client on boarding, and identify opportunities to better serve our clients with the right products and solutions. This role reports to the VP of Operations and works closely with Sales, Operations, clients, and prospective clients. The right person is a strong communicator, highly organized, client-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where follow-through and professionalism matter. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, supporting business growth, and creating an excellent client experience.

***What You’ll Do***

As the Client Relationship Manager, you will serve as a key point of contact for clients and internal teams. You will help ensure clients receive timely communication, thoughtful support, and solutions that align with their needs.

Key responsibilities include:

* Build and maintain strong relationships with current clients, prospective clients, and client contacts
* Support the Sales team by helping identify client needs, product opportunities, and service solutions
* Provide a high-quality client experience through clear communication, attention to detail, and reliable follow-through
* Assist with onboarding new clients and helping them understand Valligent’s products, services, and communication processes
* Learn and understand Valligent’s product offerings to recommend solutions that fit each client’s needs
* Monitor client reporting, turn times, and service-level expectations to help ensure client satisfaction
* Communicate client feedback, needs, and opportunities to Sales, Operations, and leadership
* Proactively identify issues and help resolve client concerns in a professional and timely manner
* Escalate sensitive or high-priority situations to executive management when appropriate
* Understand order workflows within the client management system
* Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when handling client and company information

***What We’re Looking For***

We are looking for someone who is professional, proactive, and comfortable communicating with clients and internal team members. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, dependable, and able to manage multiple priorities while keeping the client experience front and center.

**Qualified candidates should have:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong customer service or client relationship skills
* Good judgment and the ability to make thoughtful decisions that support both the client and the business
* Strong organization, planning, and follow-through
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating with Sales, Operations, and leadership
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment when handling confidential information
* Proficiency with communication tools such as Microsoft Teams, GoTo Meeting, or similar platforms
* Ability to learn client management systems and order workflows
* Typing speed of at least 45 words per minute

***Preferred Experience***  
  
The following experience is helpful but not required:

* Client success, account management, sales support, or customer service experience
* Experience in real estate valuation, appraisal, and mortgage related fields
* Experience working with client reporting, service-level agreements, or operational workflows

***Why Join Valligent?***

At Valligent, you’ll be part of a team focused on providing modern valuation solutions, strong client service, and reliable operational support. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, contribute to company growth, and play an important part in delivering a strong customer experience. If you are a strong communicator who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and helping clients succeed, we’d like to hear from you.

**Additional Information**

We offer a unique opportunity that encourages innovation and growth along with benefits that include medical, dental, vision, 401K, life, PTO, holidays and more.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. jobs.title: Assistant Brand Manager, Product Innovation
jobs.description:
**CULTIVATE A BETTER WORLD**

Food served fast does not have to be a typical fast-food experience. Chipotle has always done things differently, both in and out of our restaurants. We are changing the face of fast food, starting conversations, and directly supporting efforts to shift the future of farming and food. We hope you will join us as we continue to learn, evolve, and shape what comes next on our mission to make better food accessible to everyone.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

As the Assistant Brand Manager, Product Innovation you will help shape Chipotle’s menu innovation and go-to-market strategy by identifying new opportunities grounded in consumer insights, emerging food trends, culture, and the competitive landscape. You will actively seek out innovation pathways, staying close to what’s happening across food, culture, social media, and emerging brands to identify ideas, ingredients, formats, and partners that could unlock what’s next for Chipotle. You will partner closely with Culinary and cross-functional teams to help bring new menu items and market launches from concept to execution, supporting strategic product briefs, test markets, pricing, merchandising, and integrated marketing activation. This role will help ensure new products and launches deliver a compelling, socially relevant and consistent consumer experience across restaurants and digital channels.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Assess and identify opportunities and bring forward innovation ideas inspired by competitive landscape, emerging consumer behaviors, ingredients, cuisines, formats, brands, and cultural trends.
* Identify potential external partners and collaborators that can unlock differentiated innovation, accelerate development, or give Chipotle a relevant way into emerging cultural and food moments
* Support the development of strategic product briefs that translate consumer and business insights into clear direction for Chipotle’s Culinary team.
* Recommend timing and strategy for new menu items and support product development from concept through test market and national launch, including merchandising, pricing, and activation.
* Support new market launches by developing consumer insight-driven go-to-market strategies and briefs and coordinating cross-functionally to deliver a seamless consumer experience across restaurant and digital channels.
* Partner with internal and external communications and marketing teams, including creative agencies, experiential, social media, and digital partners, to develop and execute integrated go-to-market launch campaigns.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE TABLE**

* Bachelor's Degree in Marketing or Business from 4-year college or university
* 4+ years of relevant work experience in Brand Management experience in CPG products or Food industries with a demonstrated ability to support key organizational initiatives at a consumer-centric organization.

**PAY TRANSPARENCY**

A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position is $99,000.00–$138,000.00. You are also eligible for annual cash bonuses and equity awards based upon performance and other factors. Actual compensation offered may vary depending on skill level, experience, and/or education. Chipotle offers a competitive total rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k, sick leave, vacation time, and much more. Visit https://jobs.chipotle.com/benefits for more details.

**WHO WE ARE**

Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. (NYSE: CMG) is cultivating a better world by serving responsibly sourced, classically cooked, real food with wholesome ingredients without artificial colors, flavors or preservatives. Chipotle has restaurants in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, France and Germany and is the only restaurant company of its size that owns and operates all its restaurants in North America and Europe. With employees passionate about providing a great guest experience, Chipotle is a longtime leader and innovator in the food industry. Chipotle is committed to making its food more accessible to everyone while continuing to be a brand with a demonstrated purpose as it leads the way in digital, technology and sustainable business practices. For more information or to place an order online, visit WWW.CHIPOTLE.COM

*Chipotle Mexican Grill is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. As a people-first company rooted in values, our purpose extends beyond serving nutritious food using real ingredients. It means hiring world-class individuals and fostering a culture that champions diversity, ensures equity, and celebrates inclusion. All qualified applicants, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.*

*Qualified applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and/or certain state or local laws. Please contact* *ADAaccommodations@chipotle.com**if you need an accommodation due to a disability to complete an application, job interview, and/or to otherwise participate in the hiring process. This email does not respond to non-accommodations related requests.*

The Facility Operations Assistant Manager is a full-time position that assists the Facility Operations Manager in delivering clean and functioning facilities while providing excellent customer service. The Facility Operations Assistant Manager works the opposite schedule of the Facility Operations Manager and must be flexible to meet the needs of the business.

------------

Company Overview:

Join Allied Universal® Technology Services, a global leader in transforming the security industry. We integrate advanced technology — video surveillance, electronic access control, alarm monitoring and augmented solutions with physical security to help people feel safe. Whether you’re an installation technician, service technician, engineer, or project manager, you’ll discover rewarding opportunities to grow your career as part of a valued team.

Apply today and be phenomenal—build a meaningful career while protecting what matters most through innovative security technology.

Allied Universal® Technology Services is looking to hire a Project Coordinator. The Project Coordinator is responsible for providing administrative, project coordination, and implementation duties in support of branch Project Managers and Operations/Installation Manager. * Must possess excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work in a very fast paced environment; capable of managing multiple projects, shifting competing priorities, and meeting deadlines
* Ability to build and maintain positive working relationships with all employees, vendors, and executive level clients
* Excellent organization and analytical skills
* Ability to track multiple tasks and projects at one time and prioritize based on constantly evolving needs within the business
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite – Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint

---------------------

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the #5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. ----------------

Supermicro is currently looking for a Project Coordinator to join our team.

------------------------------------------

* **Quality Management System Support:** Help maintain and improve the QMS so processes remain aligned with applicable ISO and quality standards, internal procedures, and customer or certification requirements.

* 1+ years of experience in quality, compliance, auditing, document control, or ISO coordination preferred.
* Experience supporting ISO 9001 or another management system (e.g., ISO 13485) is a plus.
* Experience in technology, operations, logistics, or a service environment is a plus.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); familiarity with databases, document control systems, or audit/QMS software preferred.

* Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management.
