jobs.title: Fellowships Program Coordinator (5156C), Graduate Division Ops #89250
jobs.description:
Fellowships Program Coordinator (5156C), Graduate Division Ops #89250 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Graduate Funding Unit plays a central role in maintaining the highest level of academic excellence possible at UC Berkeley. We provide fellowships, funding, and program support to attract the most competitive students to our university and provide funding opportunities for students at various stages of their academic career. Our programs exist to give students opportunities to devote themselves fully to the pursuit of their scholarly and professional interests. Our knowledge and expertise in all areas of graduate funding and student life provide a strong foundation for advising the students, faculty, and staff across our vast and diverse campus.
  
  
The Student Funding team trains and advises staff and faculty departmental advisors in over 125 degree programs, offers direct advising to approximately 13,000 graduate and professional students, as well as individuals seeking admission into a graduate program at Berkeley. Training and expertise includes fellowship and academic support funding and collective bargaining agreement administration for academic student employees and graduate student researchers.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Fellowships Program Coordinator plays a significant role in supporting graduate students through the administration of Graduate Division, Campus, National, and International fellowship programs on behalf of the campus. This position works with internal and external organizations to coordinate graduate student fellowships, providing support to students, faculty, and staff from application to evaluation to awarding. The Fellowships Program Coordinator serves as an expert resource to update formulas and eligibility requirements according to national and constituent regulations and policies, ensuring proper payment of awards and monitoring compliance with fellowship terms. Additionally, this position administers and tracks the current University Fellowship allocation system, analyzes data to ensure compliance and accurate aid delivery, and partners with departmental staff to provide accurate and transparent information about funding to help students achieve their academic goals.

jobs.description:
##### **Who We Are**

VEC is a leading construction technology services provider that is at the forefront of innovation in the construction industry, delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that revolutionize the way construction projects are designed and built. Our Mission is to challenge the status quo and reshape the way we plan, design, and construct the built world so Humanity can thrive sustainably. We partner with contractors, engineers, and developers/owners across the US and deploy our team of construction and technology professionals to improve project delivery. We support large projects across many sectors of the industry: Data Centers, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Tech, Education, Transportation, Aviation, Commercial Office Space, and Public Works. We love what we do, our VECommunity, and helping the best build better.

##### **Overview**

The Digital Delivery Project Coordinator (DDPC) supports digital delivery execution on a single data center project, administering the Digital Delivery program across cross-platform data so that project-level tracking, meeting records, action logs, reporting inputs, and information flow stay current across every digital delivery workstream. The role reports to the Digital Delivery Program Manager on a single-site assignment.

The DDPC is the central driver for project data flow and performance visibility in a multi-prime infrastructure environment. The role maps cross-platform data sources, administers Delivery Control System (DCS) inputs, and translates spatial, financial, and logistical updates into executive-facing KPI dashboards. The DDPC manages the single source of truth across the full project lifecycle, works from a philosophy of evidence-driven decision making, and can build and deploy custom automated tools to measure digital asset readiness from design through operational handover. By acting as the clearing house for information flow and preventing data fragmentation, the DDPC protects the critical path of the build and frees the Program Manager to focus on campus scope, program-level risk, and client strategy.

This is a project-level coordination role rather than a technical BIM or VDC lead role. The DDPC supports program scope but does not set it, and does not own overall digital delivery strategy, multi-campus program governance, final CDE governance standards, VDC coordination execution or model quality approval, OFE procurement decisions, commissioning strategy, final handover requirements, or executive client messaging. You do not need to be a BIM expert, model author, engineer, scheduler, cost manager, or commissioning lead. You do need to understand enough to recognize missing information, overdue actions, unclear ownership, and issues that require escalation.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Delivery Administration**

* Track required documents, models, and data uploads across the project.
* Monitor late, missing, duplicate, or outdated information and chase it down before it becomes a blocker.
* Maintain meeting agendas and issue accurate minutes on time.

**Coordination, Meetings & Action Item Management**

* Maintain action item logs and keep overdue items clearly identified.
* Produce project status summaries for the Program Manager and project team.
* Administer issue and risk logs so blockers surface early.
* Track deliverable status and make sure stakeholders understand what actions they own.

**CDE, Document & Deliverable Tracking**

* Support naming, metadata, and folder-structure compliance checks in the common data environment.
* Support version-status reporting for models and key deliverables.
* Flag CDE compliance issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Review, phase out, and audit inactive users in the CDE environment.
* Keep CDE and deliverable trackers current and reduce data fragmentation across platforms.

**Reporting & Dashboard Input Support**

* Gather weekly updates from digital delivery workstream leads ahead of reporting deadlines.
* Flag missing, stale, or conflicting data before it reaches a report.
* Support weekly and monthly reporting packages, including dashboard updates.
* Administer Delivery Control System inputs and translate project updates into executive-facing KPI dashboards.

**Software & Technical Proficiency**

Proficiency needed in the following tools:

* Autodesk suite, including Forma, Navisworks, and Revit, at a level sufficient to navigate models and deliverables.
* Common data environment platforms, with the ability to run validation checksets and work to the program SOP.
* Excel, Smartsheet, or similar for trackers, logs, and spreadsheets.
* Power BI or comparable dashboard tools for reporting inputs and KPI visualization.
* AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to speed up routine work, with output checked before it goes anywhere.

##### **Who You Are**

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in construction project delivery, project coordination, document control, or digital delivery support.
* Working knowledge of construction project delivery, BIM/VDC basics, CDE and document control workflows, RFIs, submittals, issue logs, project dashboards, meeting routines, OFE and vendor tracking, and closeout or handover tracking.
* Ability to build and maintain spreadsheets, dashboards, trackers, and issue logs at scale.
* Clear written communication, particularly in meeting minutes, status summaries, and escalations.
* Ability to track action items and deadlines across many parties without letting items go quiet.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience on data center or other mission-critical technical construction projects.
* Experience in a multi-prime or multi-stakeholder project environment.
* Hands-on experience administering a common data environment, including compliance checks and user auditing.
* Experience building reporting packages or KPI dashboards for an executive audience.

jobs.description:
**Administrative Coordinator**

**Job Summary**

The Administrative Coordinator oversees daily office administration and coordinates fire sprinkler, fire alarm, fire extinguisher, and suppression system service, inspection, and installation projects. This position manages technician scheduling, customer communication, billing, project documentation, and administrative compliance tracking.

Serving as a central point of contact for customers, technicians, dispatchers, vendors, sales, design, and management, the Administrative Coordinator helps ensure work is completed efficiently, on time, and in accordance with customer expectations. Success requires strong organizational and leadership skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage changing priorities while providing professional, responsive service.

**Essential Duties**

* Coordinate daily technician schedules and service and inspection appointments based on availability, location, technician qualifications, project requirements, and customer needs.

* Plan efficient service routes, prioritize service requests, and promptly coordinate technician response to urgent repairs and emergency calls.

* Monitor work orders, project schedules, and inspection deadlines; follow up on incomplete work and communicate delays or scheduling changes.

* Reassign technicians and adjust resources to accommodate changing priorities, emergency calls, and last-minute scheduling changes.

* Communicate with local fire marshals regarding scheduling, permits, inspection documentation, and compliance inquiries; refer technical questions to appropriate personnel.

* Track field service orders, process customer invoices, record project costs, and maintain accurate billing and project records.

* Ensure technicians receive necessary job information, documentation, site access details, and resources before scheduled work.

* Serve as a primary contact and escalation point for commercial property managers and building owners regarding scheduling, project status, service updates, delays, and concerns.

* Prepare and submit fire department permit applications, business license paperwork, and technician certification documentation; monitor expiration dates and coordinate timely renewals to avoid lapses.

* Maintain clear and professional communication with customers throughout the service and project lifecycle to promote customer satisfaction.

* Collect required documentation and compile closeout packages for completed system installations.

* Maintain current customer, work order, and project information in service management systems and provide status updates as needed. Process, log, and distribute official fire alarm, sprinkler, and extinguisher inspection reports.

* Review documentation for completeness and accuracy, coordinate corrections or missing records, and support compliance with applicable state, local, and National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) documentation and reporting requirements.

* Answer phones, handle incoming and outgoing mail, maintain files, order office supplies, and support daily office operations.

* Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement solutions designed to improve scheduling efficiency, project coordination, and customer satisfaction

* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support successful project completion and department operations.

Qualifications

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in dispatch, scheduling, project coordination, office administration, or related work; experience in fire protection, construction, HVAC, plumbing, or a similar service industry preferred.

* Project coordination or project management experience is strongly preferred; experience with budgeting, project tracking, and resource allocation preferred.

* Strong organizational, scheduling, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.

* Excellent verbal and written communication and customer service skills, with the ability to maintain positive relationships with customers, technicians, vendors, and team members.

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make timely decisions, work under pressure, and adapt to changing schedules and operational needs.

* High attention to detail and accuracy in billing, inspection reports, permit records, certification tracking, and other documentation that may affect building safety or code compliance.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, including Excel, Outlook, and Teams.

* Proficiency with field service management platforms, such as ServiceTrade, HindSite, or comparable systems.

* Familiarity with fire protection terminology, systems, codes, and standards, including NFPA standards, backflow preventers, and wet and dry sprinkler systems, highly preferred.

* Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

**Education**

* High school diploma or equivalent.

* A combination of relevant education and experience may be substituted for the minimum requirements.

Reports to: Union Inspection Operations Manager

Classification: Non-exempt, In Person, Full Time

Supervisory: None

Disclaimer: This job description may not be inclusive of all assigned duties, responsibilities, or aspects of the job described, and may be amended at any time at the sole discretion of the RLH Fire Protection, Inc.

Safety/Physical Requirements

* Mostly sedentary position, with some walking and standing required.

* Ability to lift up to 25 lbs.

jobs.title: Event Coordinator (Part Time)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**  
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

 **Requirements**

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Fooda events in a variety of capacities, including: being onsite to set-up, tear down, clean equipment and site areas, problem-solve, and ensure high quality set-up and customer experience
* Gain competency with Fooda’s technology and standard operations procedures
* Problem-solve for issues such as incorrect orders, late deliveries, late restaurant arrivals, or incorrect email communication
* Troubleshoot technical issues with point-of-sale (POS) system, onsite technology, and TV menu boards
* Conduct onsite Fooda promotions and mobile app coaching
* Provide real-time onsite customer service to resolve issues promptly directly with the consumer
* Facilitate audits of restaurant event set-up to ensure consistency and high quality
* Escalate issues to Operations Manager when necessary to keep them informed or help problem solve
* Critical hours are over lunch we have positions available Monday - Friday (10 am – 2 pm) but responsibilities may span 8am-4pm, depending on the market and need

**Who You Are:**

* You love building relationships with customers and enjoy customer service
* You are friendly, high energy and love interacting with other people
* You are savvy with technology and will be comfortable in a fast-paced start-up
* You are resourceful, exhibit grace under pressure, and know you’re capable of finding solutions
* You are a strong communicator and self-starter
* You are organized and detail oriented. Type-A personality is a plus!
* You’re someone who knows the local territory and gets around efficiently in your own car
* You’re looking for a steady part-time job (between 5 - 25 hours per week) during regular business hours and value flexibility
* Prior catering or serving experience strongly preferred

 **Benefits**

**What We’ll Hook You Up With:**

* Competitive wages: $22-$23/hr based on experience level
* 401k Retirement Savings Plan with company match
* Long-term opportunities for advancement within Fooda
* Networking opportunities for work or career with local restaurants
* A fulfilling, challenging work experience and free food!

Must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No phone calls or recruiters please.

Marketing

fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

**About this role:**
--------------------

fal is looking for an Event Marketing Manager to help bring our community, developer, and broader marketing programs to life.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves producing great experiences and can move comfortably between in-person and virtual formats. You'll be working on developer and community events, meetups, webinars, third-party events, partner programs, ABM activations, and other marketing moments as our event portfolio grows.

We’re looking for someone who is equally comfortable building a run of show, configuring a webinar platform, coordinating speakers, working with vendors, and being onsite making sure every detail comes together.

* Hands-on experience producing webinars or virtual events and confidence managing the technical details behind them
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple programs, stakeholders, and deadlines at once

* Experience at an AI, developer tools, infrastructure, or high-growth technology company
* Experience with event registration, webinar, CRM, or marketing automation platforms
* Familiarity with hackathons, developer workshops, or hands-on technical programming

* A lot of learning and growth opportunities

jobs.title: Event & Community Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
============

We're living through a fundamental shift in how people discover, evaluate, and purchase products. The next generation doesn't respond to traditional marketing - they build relationships with brands through authentic social interactions, seek recommendations from communities they trust, and expect personalized experiences that feel human, not corporate.

At Nectar Social, we're building the AI-native social operating system that enables this new era of commerce. We believe every social interaction should deepen the relationship between brands and their communities while creating genuine value for both sides.

Founded by ex-Meta product and engineering leaders, we've raised over $30M in total capital from investors including GV and True Ventures. We work with brands like Oura Health, Caraway, e.l.f. Cosmetics, Kosas, OLIPOP, and many more. We're building the future of social commerce - where community, conversation, and commerce converge.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring an Event & Community Manager based in Palo Alto to own our West Coast events. This is the founding role for our West Coast events program: you'll build it across the Bay Area and Los Angeles from the ground up, with no existing playbook to inherit and full ownership over how it takes shape. You'll design and run the experiences that bring our customers, prospects, and industry community together, from intimate dinners and executive roundtables to conference presence. You'll also help grow Nectar's community alongside the broader marketing team.

The Bay Area is home base. From Palo Alto to San Francisco, it's where we connect with tech founders, investors, and B2B operators. Los Angeles is where we show up for consumer brands, creators, and agencies. You'll split your time between both and make Nectar a known name in each.

You'll report directly to the marketing leadership team and work closely with sales, customer success, and the founders to make sure every event and community touchpoint ladders up to pipeline, retention, and brand.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Events**

* Own end-to-end planning and execution for Nectar's West Coast event calendar across SF and LA: customer dinners, executive roundtables, happy hours, creator meetups, and conference sponsorships and booths.
* Run account-based event programs with sales: executive dinners and roundtables built around target accounts, with a follow-up plan for every attendee.
* Build a recurring event series in both cities so Nectar has a consistent, recognizable presence in each market.
* Manage budgets, vendors, venues, and logistics in both cities, and build repeatable processes so events scale smoothly as the company grows.
* Partner with sales and customer success on event strategies that generate pipeline and deepen relationships with existing customers.
* Track and report on event ROI (attendance, sourced and influenced pipeline, and customer sentiment), and use that data to sharpen the calendar over time.
* Represent Nectar at West Coast industry conferences and manage on-site logistics, staffing, and sponsor deliverables.

### **Community**

* Support the launch and growth of Nectar's customer and industry community program (e.g., a Slack community, ambassador program, or customer council).
* Help run the content and engagement cadence that keeps the community active: AMAs, office hours, member spotlights, and peer-to-peer discussion.
* Use in-person events to feed the community, turning SF and LA attendees into active members.
* Build authentic relationships with key West Coast customers, creators, and industry voices.
* Identify and cultivate community advocates who can support case studies, referrals, and word-of-mouth growth.
* Feed community insights and feedback back to the product, marketing, and customer success teams.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 5-8 years of experience in B2B event marketing, community management, or a hybrid of both, with most of it at B2B SaaS companies.
* A track record of running B2B field and executive events end-to-end, from concept through post-event reporting, that sourced and accelerated pipeline alongside sales.
* Fluency in B2B event measurement: campaign attribution in HubSpot or Salesforce, sourced versus influenced pipeline, and post-event follow-up with target accounts.
* Experience supporting or growing an online or in-person community.
* Based in or near Palo Alto, with working knowledge of the Bay Area and LA event scenes: the venues, the vendors, and the people worth knowing.
* Comfort operating with high autonomy in an early-stage environment where processes don't exist yet. You're excited to build them.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to juggle multiple events across two markets without dropping details.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a real interest in connecting with people.
* Willingness to travel regularly to San Francisco, Los Angeles, and industry conferences (estimated 20-30%).

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in the social media, marketing technology, or creator economy space.
* Experience marketing to brand, social, or marketing leaders as the buyer.
* An existing network in Bay Area tech and in LA's consumer brand or creator communities.
* Familiarity with community platforms (Slack, Discord, Circle) and event tools (Luma, Bizzabo, HubSpot).
* Prior experience as an early hire at a startup, building a function from zero to one.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation and early equity
* Health, vision, and dental benefits + 401(k) match
* ClassPass membership for fitness and wellness classes
* $50/month mobile stipend for all employees, and $50/month internet stipend for remote employees

**For our Palo Alto Office:**

* Hybrid schedule: 4 days in office, plus 3 remote flex days per quarter (after your first 3 months)
* Free lunch in the heart of University

jobs.title: Development Coordinator (Temporary Role)
jobs.description:
**Homeless Children’s Network**

**Position Title:** Development Coordinator (Temporary Role)

**SALARY:** $35-$40 per hour

**SCHEDULE:** Temporary role (3 month Contract), 40 hours/week; some evenings

**BENEFITS:** Health, Dental, and Vision insurance; Commuter stipend

**HOMELESS CHILDREN’S NETWORK MISSION STATEMENT**

Homeless Children’s Network’s (HCN) mission is to decrease the trauma of homelessness and domestic violence for children, youth, and families; to empower families; and to increase the effectiveness of collaborative efforts among service providers to end homelessness and poverty. Since 1992, HCN has empowered San Francisco’s underserved and historically marginalized communities citywide toward a brighter future with love, wholeness, and healing.

**About Homeless Children’s Network (HCN)**

Since 1992, HCN has been San Francisco’s leading nonprofit agency for comprehensive early intervention and mental health support for underserved and historically marginalized children, youth, and families experiencing homelessness, housing instability, or living in intergenerational poverty. Our mobile therapeutic model is both accessible and scalable, enabling clinicians to meet clients directly in the community. As the hub of a Collaborative of 60+ service agencies and community-based organizations, we serve over 2,500 clients each year, reaching those most reluctant to trust conventional mental health systems. Central to our work is our Afri-centric mental health and wellness model. This community-defined approach addresses health inequities and the persistent cycle of racism and trauma over generations. This model not only uplifts the Black/African American communities but also strengthens the behavioral health outcomes of all San Franciscans, fostering resilience, healing, and lasting change.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

HCN is seeking a hands-on Temporary Development Coordinator to support our development team through a busy season. Over the next three months, this role will help deliver events, support our year-end giving campaign, and assist with development and grants operations while team members are out.

This is a great fit for an organized, flexible fundraising professional who can step in quickly, juggle deadlines, and work well with a small, mission-driven team.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Events (approx. 40%)**

* Support logistics for event on 10/27, Thanksgiving Drive, and Holiday Drive

* Assist with managing guest list, name tags, and check-in

* Support online auction implementation

* Support event materials such as invitations, programs, signage and slides

* Coordinate volunteers; staff events on the days

* Handle post-event follow-up: thank-yous, gift entry and a short wrap-up report

**Year-end giving campaign (approx. 20%)**

* Support Development Associate with production and mailing of the year-end appeal

* Support Giving Tuesday and December giving activities

**Development operations and coverage (approx. 20%)**

* Assist Development Associate with Database Management

* Prepare timely acknowledgment letters and tax receipts

* Cover routine tasks as needed

* Update welcome series for newsletter and volunteer sign ups

* Update thank you letters

* Maintain shared trackers, calendars and files

**Grant support (approx. 20%)**

* Support Associate Development Director with grants as needed, including gathering attachments, budgets and required documents for proposals and reports

* Update the grants calendar and track deadlines and submission confirmations for the Associate Development Director, Grants

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

* 2+ years of nonprofit fundraising, event coordination or development operations experience
* Experience planning or supporting fundraising events from start to finish
* Strong organization and the ability to manage several deadlines at once
* Clear, professional writing and attention to detail
* Experience with a donor database (such as Raiser's Edge, Salesforce, Bloomerang or DonorPerfect)
* Comfort with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace
* Available for occasional evening and weekend work around events
* Able to start quickly and work independently with limited onboarding

**Preferred**

* Experience with year-end or direct mail appeals
* Familiarity with grant applications and foundation reporting
* Experience with email marketing tools (such as Mailchimp or Constant Contact)
* Knowledge of or commitment to serving children and families experiencing homelessness

**HCN’s Community Culture**

*Of all the above important qualifications, bring the heartfelt quality of compassion, with exquisite cultural responsiveness as a primary guiding quality, not only of your professional life, but of what you hold dear.*

*Please bring a strong analysis of how race, ethnicity, culture, language, region, poverty, sexual and gender identity, age, education, opportunities and resources generationally made available or not, and systemic oppressions impact a person’s mental health.*

*Please have stories of your own life and how you have been a mover and shaker to transform these systems.*

*Please accept that HCN is a vibrant community that has a legacy that is of interest to you, and is also prompted to grow steadily, and with the respect of what has been done well central in the conversation.*

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

I am Sarah Wagner Rayburn, co-founder of Marin Home Team at Compass. We have been serving Marin County clients for over twenty-five years and have built a reputation on deep local knowledge, strong relationships, and attention to detail.

I am looking for a Business Operations Manager to work directly with me.

This is a hands-on role for someone organized, proactive and tech-comfortable who genuinely enjoys making things run well. You will be the person who keeps the wheels turning so I can focus on what I do best, which is serving clients.

It is not a sit-behind-a-desk-all-day job. Some days you are in the field, checking on listings, making keys, meeting vendors. Other days you are at your computer, managing paperwork, updating systems, building marketing materials. You need to be based in Southern Marin, or happy to drive to Mill Valley every day.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**TRANSACTION SUPPORT, WHICH IS THE CORE OF THE ROLE**

You will manage the operational backbone of every deal, from listing or buyer prep through to closing.

LISTINGS. Work with our transaction coordinator to prepare disclosure packages. Coordinate inspections and vendor work. Manage timelines. Handle MLS prep and entry. Develop marketing materials. Coordinate photography and photo selection. Keep everything organized in Compass and our team systems.

BUYERS. Set up new buyer files in Notejoy and Compass Business Tracker. Set up Compass Collections and Top Agent Network searches. Prepare paperwork. Track escrow timelines.

CONTRACTS AND PAPERWORK. Prep offers and other transactional documents. Manage DocuSign and Compass e-sign workflows. Review documents for accuracy. Handle contingency removals and timeline deadlines. Execute referral agreements.

ESCROW. Track deadlines across all active transactions. Anticipate upcoming needs. Coordinate with lenders, title companies and clients.

**LISTING MARKETING**

PROPERTY MARKETING. Write property descriptions and marketing copy, working with me and with AI. Create flyers and brochures using Compass tools. Build and send marketing emails. Update our team website and individual listing sites.

BRAND CONSISTENCY. Keep MarinHome.Team current and cohesive. Maintain Compass collateral and marketing materials. Make sure our brand looks polished at every touchpoint.

**DAILY OPERATIONS**

THE INBOX. Monitor and manage email related to my transactions, plus Slack and text. Field questions and requests. Route things to the right person.

THE CALENDAR. Maintain and update the calendar. Coordinate showing schedules. Schedule vendor appointments. Track inspection and timeline deadlines.

CRM AND DATABASE. Manage Compass Contact Management. Track client relationships, update contact records, manage my buyer and seller pipelines, track sales data for reporting.

INFORMATION MANAGEMENT. Maintain our Notejoy workspace: buyer profiles, vendor lists, listing details, templates, passwords. Create and update shared documents. Keep everything organized and findable.

**TECH AND AI**

Explore parts of the Compass platform we are not using, or could be using better, and bring back what would actually help. Work with me on building AI tools that make the business run more efficiently.

This is a real part of the job, not a nice-to-have. We use AI daily for writing, organizing and streamlining, and I am actively building more of it.

**IN THE FIELD**

BOOTS ON THE GROUND. Check on listings for lights, lockboxes and signage. Meet vendors and inspectors on site. Pick up and make keys. Coordinate staging logistics. Handle broker tour catering and setup.

CLIENT-FACING MOMENTS. You may deal with clients by phone or in person. You will need to be warm, professional and comfortable representing the Marin Home Team.

VENDORS. Schedule inspectors, stagers, photographers and contractors. Manage quotes and project timelines. Maintain our vendor list.

**ADMIN**

EXPENSES. Add my expenses to the team tracker, pay invoices, keep the records straight.

SUBSCRIPTIONS AND TOOLS. Manage operational subscriptions such as the website, Dropbox and Zoom. Troubleshoot tech issues. Research new tools.

INDUSTRY. Attend Compass meetings and industry events as needed, take notes, keep me informed.

REPORTING. Enter new listings and buyer activity in our business tracker. Monitor Top Agent. Network for inventory and opportunities.

**THE FIRST SIX WEEKS**

My days are genuinely different from one another, and real estate does not run to a tidy schedule. So rather than pretend I know exactly which hours I will need you and get it wrong, the first six weeks are a working trial for both of us.

Part of your job in those six weeks is helping me work out what the rhythm actually is. Which days, which hours, what gets batched, what has to happen live. At the end of it we lock in a schedule that reflects reality, and you will know what you are agreeing to because you helped build it.

If it is not right for either of us at that point, we shake hands and part on good terms.

**WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR:**

THE ESSENTIALS

* You are organized in a way other people notice and appreciate
* You are a problem solver who anticipates what is needed before being asked
* You are comfortable with technology and pick up new tools quickly
* You communicate clearly, professionally and warmly
* You can work independently and manage your own time
* You are based in Southern Marin, or happy to drive to Mill Valley daily. This role needs you physically present here on a regular basis
* You have strong computer skills: Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, Claude, and a willingness to learn whatever else comes

NICE TO HAVE

* Previous experience in real estate operations, or somewhere similarly client-facing and
* detail-heavy
* Comfort with CRM systems. Compass experience is a bonus and not a requirement
* Marketing or design skills
* Social media experience
* Experience with DocuSign, Dropbox, Slack or other project manageme

**Account Executive, Public Relations (Financial Services)**
============================================================

Account Executives at Highwire are passionate communicators and collaborative team players who bring client programs to life. On our Financial Services team, they work with leading and emerging brands in financial services, banking, insurance technology, and other financial industries. They support media relations, content development, and client program execution that help clients stand out in complex markets. Account Executives are strong writers, proactive problem solvers, and eager learners who excel in media relations, client management, and strategic storytelling.

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

### **Client Service & Program Support**

* Support day-to-day contact for client teams and help manage project timelines and deliverables.
* Participate in client calls and contribute to status updates, coverage reports, and next-step planning.
* Support program execution across media relations, awards, speaking, and thought leadership campaigns.
Research industry trends, competitors, and breaking news to identify media or commentary opportunities.  

### **Media & Influencer Relations**

* Support media outreach efforts by building and maintaining journalist lists and researching new opportunities.
* Draft and send high-quality media pitches and press materials that align with client goals.
* Help monitor and report on media coverage and trends in business, finance, and financial services.
Assist in developing and managing clients' social media and amplification strategies, especially on LinkedIn.  

### **Writing & Content Development**

* Draft and edit PR materials, including press releases, pitches, blogs, bios, and award submissions.
* Translate complex business or financial topics into clear, engaging stories.
Ensure consistency in tone, quality, and key messaging across all written content.  

### **Insights & Reporting**

* Track and analyze media results, providing clear reports and takeaways for clients.
* Help identify ways to use analytics and media performance data to strengthen storytelling and outreach.
Collaborate with internal teams (content, design, digital) to ensure integrated program delivery.  

### **Team Collaboration & Growth**

* Work closely with senior team members to support strategy execution and learn best practices.
* Take initiative on projects, communicate progress clearly, and seek feedback regularly.
Contribute to a positive, collaborative team culture built on respect and accountability.  

**Success Factors:**
--------------------

* 2–3 years of PR or communications experience, in an agency environment
* Familiarity or interest in financial services, insurtech, or banking industries
* Strong writing and editing skills across a variety of formats
* A growing network of media contacts and enthusiasm for media relations
* Excellent organization and attention to detail
* A proactive, flexible, and collaborative attitude
* Familiarity with analytics and reporting tools (a plus)

  

*The salary range for this position is $54,000 to $72,000, with the final offer based on a combination of factors, including education, relevant experience, skills, prior training, internal equity, and local geographic market data. As a values-driven agency, we foster an inclusive environment where everyone—regardless of age, race/ethnicity, size, shape, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion and different abilities–can feel safe, celebrated and worthy.

If you thrive in an environment that values personal accountability, high standards, and boundless motivation, this is the opportunity for you. Be part of our award-winning culture and contribute to an exciting and growing business where you can make a real impact.

jobs.title: Arborist Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Overview**:

If you enjoy working outdoors in a professional and safe environment, consider a career with Bartlett Tree Experts! At Bartlett, we value a strong culture of excellence in safety, scientific research, lifelong learning, and career development.

Bartlett Tree Experts is currently seeking a full-time Arborist Representative to join our growing team. This is a unique opportunity to combine your passion for arboriculture and enthusiasm for sharing knowledge to establish positive client relationships. As an Arborist Representative, you will play an integral role in helping grow our business by developing and maintaining long-term client relationships. You will be responsible for visiting client properties, assessing their tree and shrub care needs, and providing scientific tree and shrub care recommendations.

**Benefits**:

* **Compensation:** $70,000-$125,000 annual draw based on experience plus commission
* A safety-first culture and professional workplace
* Advancement opportunities - we promote from within
* Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
* 401k retirement plan
* Paid time off and holidays
* Company provided uniforms, vehicle, laptop, and cell phone
* Access to training, continuing education programs, and a variety of resources provided by the Bartlett Tree Experts Research Laboratories Charlotte, NC

To find out more about what life is like at Bartlett, check us out on Instagram @LifeatBartlett.

**Responsibilities**:

* Responsible for all areas of sales within a defined territory, including selling, marketing, customer service, administration, production, and training  
  + Meet with existing and potential residential and commercial clients daily to evaluate their tree and shrub care needs
  + Establish, develop, and maintain positive business and client relationships within the defined territory
  + Prepare and provide proposals to clients utilizing sales process tools, software, and other technologies
  + Supervise work to be performed, ensuring jobs are completed based on the signed contract and to the client's satisfaction
  + Set up personal sales expectations with immediate supervisor and prepare to meet sales goals
* Responsible for implementing and enforcing all safety, transportation, and pesticide compliance programs

**Qualifications**:

* 1-3 years of related experience in the tree care industry or prior sales experience
* ISA Arborist Certification or ability to obtain – we will pay for the cost of the exam and help you prepare!
* Ability to learn to identify trees and shrubs common to the region, diagnose pests and diseases, and recommend corrective action or proactive management plans
* Valid driver's license
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Degree in Arboriculture, Forestry, Horticulture, Turfgrass, Environmental Science, Plant Science, Outdoor Recreation, Agriculture or a related field is preferred but not required

*The F. A. Bartlett Tree Expert Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

jobs.title: Business Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
About Integrity Landscape Management

Integrity Landscape Management supports a growing group of operating companies serving commercial and institutional clients across the San Francisco Bay Area. Our Enterprise Systems & Technology team connects business operations, systems, BI, and process discipline so teams can scale with clearer workflows, stronger controls, and better information.

About the Role

Integrity Landscape Management is seeking a Business Operations Specialist to join our Enterprise Systems & Technology team. This hands-on role sits at the intersection of business operations, enterprise systems, process improvement, and implementation.

You will help ensure recurring operational processes are clearly defined, documented, coordinated, and completed consistently across our operating companies. The work includes ERP-enabled workflows, billing and month-end readiness, implementation support, documentation, training, issue follow-up, and business changes such as new contracts and integrations.

We are looking for someone who can take a business objective, organize the work, coordinate the people involved, work comfortably within ERP and business systems, track open items, and follow through until completion.

What You'll Do

· Own and coordinate assigned recurring business processes, including deadlines, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and completion.

· Gather business requirements and translate them into practical workflows, ownership structures, documentation, and implementation steps.

· Coordinate operational workflows within ERP and other business applications, including contracts, properties, recurring services, work tickets, billing readiness, payroll preparation, month-end activities, and related processes.

· Support system and process implementations through requirements gathering, testing/UAT, rollout, training, issue tracking, stabilization, and follow-up.

· Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, process maps, ownership records, implementation trackers, recurring calendars, and training materials.

· Identify incomplete, inaccurate, or overdue items; organize owners and next steps and follow through until resolution.

· Work cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, branch teams, managers, and other business functions across multiple operating companies.

· Coordinate assigned operational work performed by supporting Data Associates, including priorities, deadlines, handoffs, and follow-up.

· Provide hands-on operational support when needed to maintain continuity, resolve bottlenecks, or meet critical deadlines.

· Support new contracts, branch changes, acquisitions, integrations, and other business changes through structured implementation and follow-through.

· Identify opportunities to improve, standardize, simplify, or automate recurring business processes.

· Partner with reporting and analytics resources to improve the quality, consistency, and readiness of operational data used for recurring reporting and decision-making.

What We're Looking For

· 5+ years of experience in business operations, business systems support, process ownership, implementation/project coordination, or a similar cross-functional role.

· Strong ownership and follow-through; able to move work from assignment through completion without constant direction.

· Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines, stakeholders, handoffs, recurring cycles, and open items.

· Comfortable learning and working within ERP systems and other business applications.

· Ability to create clear, practical SOPs, checklists, process maps, documentation, and training materials.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills and comfort working with both field-based and corporate teams.

· Strong Excel and general data literacy, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, filtering, reconciliation, and recurring operational files.

· Ability to work independently once objectives, priorities, and boundaries have been established.

· Ability to work periodically from the Richmond office and other Bay Area company locations as business needs require.

Preferred Experience

· Field services, landscaping, facilities, construction services, property services, logistics, or another multi-location service organization.

· ERP or business systems experience; Aspire experience is a plus.

· System implementations, UAT/testing, training, or rollout activities.

· Power BI, SharePoint, Power Automate, or similar business tools.

· Multi-company or multi-branch operating environments.

Who Will Succeed in This Role

This role is well suited for a systems-comfortable operator: someone who understands business operations, learns technology quickly, brings structure to processes that are not always perfectly documented, and follows through across multiple stakeholders. You should be comfortable moving between process design and practical execution - documenting a workflow one day, supporting testing or training the next, and helping resolve an operational exception when a deadline is approaching.

This is not primarily an administrative assistant, IT help desk, software engineering, BI/dashboard development, or strategy-only role. Success requires both coordination and execution: organizing the work, maintaining the process, following through on open items, and helping ensure the operation closes the loop.

What Success Looks Like

· Recurring processes have clear owners, deadlines, documentation, and controls.

· Open items and exceptions are surfaced early and followed through to closure.

· System and process changes move through testing, rollout, training, and stabilization in a structured way.

· Cross-functional teams have clearer handoffs and fewer missed steps.

· Business data is more complete and reliable at billing, payroll, and month-end deadlines.

This role will support program staff, contractors, field personnel and clients to develop energy efficiency projects targeting multifamily building customers related to energy conservation measures (ECMs) that reduce gas (and/or electric) usage, or for electrification of buildings.

* Review inspection results to provide contractors with recommended actions to ensure program compliance for installation and operation.
* Monitor program tasks, reporting and follow-up on progress and achievements.

* Knowledge of software tools, such as, spreadsheets, project management programs, word processing, presentation and workflow programs, and program tracking tools and techniques.

**Research Coordinator**
========================

The Research Coordinator serves as the Core Imaging Laboratory (CIL) Manager for the Chronic Subdural Hematoma Treatment with Embolization Versus Surgery Study (CHESS), a multicenter clinical trial within the Department of Medicine at RWJBarnabas Health. The CIL Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational management of centralized imaging workflows and serves as a critical connection between participating study sites, the Central Imaging Laboratory, and the study team.

By coordinating the acquisition, verification, processing, secure storage, and quality control of clinical imaging data, the CIL Manager helps ensure the integrity, accuracy, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance of imaging data used in clinical research. This role works closely with study investigators and participating sites to maintain protocol adherence, support blinded analysis, and ensure imaging workflows remain consistent, efficient, and audit-ready throughout the study.

**A Typical Day:**
------------------

As a Research Coordinator, a typical day might include the following:

* Coordinating the acquisition, transfer, verification, and secure storage of CT imaging data from participating clinical trial sites.
* Managing day-to-day imaging workflows within the centralized, independent Core Imaging Laboratory.
* Serving as the primary point of contact between participating study sites and the Central Imaging Laboratory regarding imaging submissions and study requirements.
* Reviewing incoming imaging data for completeness, accuracy, quality, and compliance with study protocols.
* Performing quality checks on submitted imaging studies and identifying missing, incomplete, or inconsistent data.
* Communicating with site personnel to resolve imaging discrepancies and ensure appropriate data submissions.
* Overseeing image processing workflows using imaging technologies and platforms such as DICOM, PACS, and AMBRA.
* Monitoring adherence to imaging acquisition and submission protocols across participating study sites.
* Ensuring imaging workflows comply with study requirements, institutional policies, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Maintaining accurate, complete, and audit-ready documentation related to imaging submissions, quality checks, processing, and study activities.
* Ensuring compliance with blinded image analysis procedures and maintaining the confidentiality and security of clinical research data.
* Preparing and batching imaging datasets for independent analysis in accordance with study protocols.
* Supporting regulatory documentation, reporting requirements, and study deliverables in coordination with the research team.
* Assisting with training and onboarding participating site personnel on imaging submission procedures, requirements, and workflows.
* Maintaining secure imaging archives in accordance with institutional policies and applicable NIH and research standards.
* Monitoring the overall imaging workflow to identify operational issues and implement appropriate solutions in collaboration with the study team.
* Collaborating with the Clinical Review Committee (CRC) Manager to ensure continuity of Core Imaging Laboratory operations when the CIL Manager is unavailable.
* Supporting other clinical research activities, operational needs, and study-related assignments as directed.

**This Role Might Be For You If:**
----------------------------------

* You are passionate about clinical research and are interested in contributing to studies that improve the treatment and outcomes of patients with neurological conditions.
* You have a strong understanding of clinical research processes and the importance of accurate, reliable, and secure research data.
* You are highly organized and comfortable managing complex imaging workflows involving multiple clinical trial sites.
* You understand the importance of following study protocols and maintaining consistent processes across a multicenter clinical trial.
* You have strong attention to detail and can identify discrepancies, missing information, and quality issues within clinical imaging data.
* You are comfortable communicating with physicians, research staff, imaging personnel, and participating study sites.
* You can work independently while knowing when to seek guidance and collaborate with investigators and members of the study team.
* You are comfortable working with medical imaging systems and technologies such as DICOM, PACS, and AMBRA.
* You understand the importance of confidentiality, blinded analysis, data security, and regulatory compliance in clinical research.
* You are able to manage competing priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and meet study timelines.
* You have strong analytical, organizational, interpersonal, and written and verbal communication skills.
* You are interested in neurosurgery, neurology, neuroradiology, neurovascular conditions, or related areas of clinical research.
* You are comfortable supporting training, troubleshooting, and workflow coordination across multiple participating research sites.
* You value collaboration and understand the importance of maintaining contin

jobs.description:
A New York City Council member, representing District 4 , is seeking an enthusiastic and highly organized Scheduler & Office Operations Coordinator. The individual will oversee the Council Member’s daily and long-term schedule, field meeting requests, and support office operations as needed, to ensure the Council Member’s time reflects office priorities.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Executive Assistant:

* Provide day-to-day executive assistance to the Council Member, including managing her correspondence and email inbox, keeping her on schedule, and tracking follow-up items from meetings and routing them to the appropriate staff.
* Prepare the Member for each engagement by assembling and maintaining the weekly briefing binder, writing briefing memos that cover attendees, background, key issues and talking points, and compiling relevant legislation and prior meeting notes.

Scheduling:

* Manage the Council Member's daily and forward calendar, including meetings, site visits, hearings, events and occasional travel, while reviewing incoming requests, maintaining holds and RSVPs, and confirming logistics with outside parties.
* Prepare a daily schedule each evening with locations, contacts, timing and materials, handle last-minute changes with professionalism, and coordinate with the Chief of Staff and the legislative and communications teams so the calendar reflects office priorities.

Office Operations Coordination:

* Manage the district office's day-to-day operations, including triaging the general inbox, voicemail and mail, ensuring phones are answered from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., and maintaining shared calendars, filing systems, contact lists, and productivity and task management systems in coordination with the Chief of Staff.
* Order office supplies before stock runs low, track non-personnel (OTPS) spending, coordinate with building management, vendors and IT on equipment and facility needs, and lead by example in keeping the office, kitchen and common areas clean and professional.
* Oversee weekly staff meeting agendas in coordination with the Council Member and team, provide hands-on logistical support to the Community Liaison team for public-facing events, from identifying venues to stakeholder outreach, and support the Chief of Staff with office procedures and additional administrative projects as needed.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience as an executive assistant, scheduler, office manager, or in a similar administrative role; experience in a government, political, or nonprofit office a plus.
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong writing skills, including the ability to produce clear, concise briefing memos on short notice.
* Sound judgment, discretion, responsiveness, and professionalism in handling confidential information and high-profile contacts.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable working with elected officials, agency staff, and community leaders from diverse backgrounds.

jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**JCCA** is one of New York’s **leading child welfare and children’s behavioral health organizations**, serving thousands of children, youth, and families each year. Through preventive services, foster care, behavioral health, residential programs, education, and community-based supports, we help children and families thrive.

We are seeking a **dynamic, relationship-oriented Outreach Coordinator** to expand awareness of JCCA’s programs, strengthen community partnerships, and develop referral opportunities across our child welfare and behavioral health services.

This is a highly visible, community-facing role for someone who enjoys **building relationships, connecting people and organizations to resources, and creating partnerships that make a difference.** The Outreach Coordinator will serve as an ambassador for JCCA, developing relationships with schools, healthcare providers, community organizations, government agencies, referral sources, and other stakeholders throughout New York City, with a particular focus on the **Bronx and Brooklyn**.

### **Summary of Responsibilities**

**Build Community Partnerships**

* Develop and maintain relationships with community organizations, schools, healthcare providers, government agencies, referral sources, and other stakeholders.
* Represent JCCA at community meetings, conferences, networking events, resource fairs, and public forums.
* Conduct presentations and informational sessions to increase awareness of JCCA programs and services.
* Identify opportunities to develop new partnerships and strengthen existing relationships.
* Maintain regular communication and follow-up with community partners.

**Community Engagement & Referral Development**

* Support outreach efforts connecting children, youth, and families with JCCA’s child welfare, behavioral health, educational, and family support services.
* Partner with program leadership to understand service priorities, referral needs, and opportunities for growth.
* Identify community resources, service gaps, emerging needs, and potential referral pathways, particularly in the Bronx and Brooklyn.
* Monitor community feedback and referral activity to identify trends, barriers, and opportunities to improve access to services.
* Support culturally responsive outreach to diverse and underserved communities.

**Program Promotion & Outreach Coordination**

* Collaborate with program and communications teams to promote JCCA’s services and community resources.
* Assist with outreach materials, presentations, campaigns, special events, and other engagement initiatives.
* Share feedback and recommendations with program leadership to inform outreach and engagement strategies.
* Maintain accurate records of community contacts, referral sources, outreach activities, and partnership opportunities.
* Track outreach activities and follow-up and prepare regular updates for leadership.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Services, Social Work, Public Health, Communications, Marketing, Business, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be considered.
* At least **3 years of experience** in community outreach, business development, community relations, behavioral health, healthcare, child welfare, education, nonprofit organizations, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with diverse stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong organization, follow-through, and project coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently while collaborating effectively with others.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and CRM/database systems.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* **Bilingual Spanish/English strongly preferred.**
* Experience in child welfare, behavioral health, healthcare, education, or other family-serving systems.
* Familiarity with New York City communities, particularly the Bronx and Brooklyn.
* Experience presenting to community groups or professional audiences.

### **Additional Requirements**

* Ability to travel throughout New York City, including the Bronx and Brooklyn, **at least weekly**.
* Valid driver’s license and/or ability to travel independently using public transportation.
* Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends for community events, partner meetings, and outreach activities.
* Commitment to JCCA’s mission and dedication to serving children, youth, and families.

### **Why Join JCCA?**

At JCCA, your work helps strengthen the connection between children, families, and the services they need. This is an opportunity to build meaningful community partnerships, expand access to critical services, and make a lasting impact.

**If you are an energetic relationship builder who enjoys being out in the community and creating opportunities for children and families, we want to hear from you!**

**Compensation:** $67,000 annually

**What the day will look like**

**Education and licensing requirements:**

* A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred for this position. Maintain Notary Public designation and hold the appropriate Producer license.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a motivated Account Manager to join our SMB Account Management team in New York City.

On-Target Earnings (OTE): $103,000

**Working at WGSN**  
**Together, we create tomorrow**

Embark on an exciting career with WGSN, where we offer dynamic opportunities for growth and development in a fast-paced, results-driven environment. We are looking for talented Sales and Account Management professionals to join our team and help drive success by delivering WGSN’s trusted insights to our global clients.

As part of our team, you'll work with a diverse group of experts—from trend forecasters and data analysts to designers and content creators—all united by a common goal: to shape the future of design and innovation. You’ll help clients navigate trends across industries including consumer tech, beauty, fashion, interiors and lifestyle, empowering them to create outstanding products.

At WGSN, we believe in the power of consumer and design forecasts to transform businesses. If you have a passion for building strong client relationships, driving commercial growth and helping customers get greater value from the products they use, we want to hear from you.  
Join us at WGSN and take your career in Sales and Account Management to the next level while contributing to the creation of tomorrow's groundbreaking products and services.

**Role Overview**

In this role, you’ll manage a portfolio of small and medium-sized business (SMB) clients with lower contract values, taking ownership of their renewal, retention and growth with WGSN.

This is a high-volume account management role, so being organized, commercially focused and comfortable managing multiple priorities at once will be critical. You’ll oversee a larger portfolio of clients and renewal opportunities, ensuring accounts receive the right level of engagement while keeping momentum across your book of business.

Your primary focus will be retaining existing revenue, identifying risk early and finding opportunities to grow accounts through additional products, teams or longer-term partnerships where there is a clear client need.

* Manage an SMB Portfolio: Own a portfolio of small and medium-sized clients across lower contract values, balancing multiple accounts, renewal cycles and commercial opportunities at the same time.

* Build Client Relationships: Develop relationships with key users and decision-makers across your accounts, understanding their priorities and ensuring WGSN continues to demonstrate value.
* Communicate WGSN’s Value: Deliver engaging product demonstrations, presentations and commercial proposals tailored to clients across industries including Fashion, Beauty, Food & Drink, Interiors and Consumer Tech.
* Maintain an Accurate Pipeline: Keep Salesforce current and accurate, including opportunities, client notes, next steps, close dates and forecasts, providing clear visibility into the health and performance of your portfolio.
* Work Collaboratively: Partner with colleagues across Account Management, Client Services, Product and other teams to support clients while maintaining ownership of the commercial relationship.
* Meet Clients Locally: Build relationships through in-person client engagement where it adds value, primarily across New York City and the Tri-State area.

**Skills, Experience & Qualifications Required**

* B2B Sales or Account Management Experience: Ideally 2+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, customer growth or another commercial role.

jobs.description:
**Mission**
-----------

The US healthcare system is complex, error-prone, and financially draining. Medical bills and insurance coverage shouldn’t be this hard to navigate. At Granted, we’re building the one solution every American can turn to for help.

Thanks to AI and new regulations, Granted can fight claim denials, correct billing errors, negotiate and lower bills, and make coverage easier to understand—saving people time, money, and stress. Our goal is simple: to be the American’s most trusted advocate and partner to manage their healthcare, and healthcare financial decisions.

**About Us**
------------

Founded by a former Oscar Health leader, we’re a seed-stage company with $17M in funding. We’re lucky to be backed by the founders and investors at Hugging Face, Rocket Money, Oscar Health, CaseText, Forerunner Ventures, RRE Ventures, and more. We are well-funded and have solid runway.

Bill lowering is the hook. People come to us when they have a bill they can't afford or don't understand. Granted checks it — catches errors, overcharges and denials, secures financial assistance, and negotiates with providers. That earns us the right to be connected to their insurance and their patient data, and from there Granted runs in the background, proactively monitoring every bill to help patients lower and pay what they owe.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re hiring our first in-house Digital Marketing Production Designer to own hands-on creative production across web, email, collateral, and video. You take a brief: usually from marketing and turn it into finished, on-brand assets ready to ship. This is a high-volume execution role: multiple landing pages, email templates, ad cuts, and decks each week, all held to Granted’s brand system and healthcare compliance rules.

One thing to flag up front: ads, landing pages, and emails are the core requirement. Video editing is a strong plus, not a must-have.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Landing page design**

* Design and revise marketing-site and campaign landing pages in Figma (partner pages, patient-stories page, signup screens, and similar).
* Design mobile-first, keep animation minimal, and match each page to the ad that drove the click.
* Work from copy briefs and conversion benchmarks, not aesthetics alone.

### **Email design**

* Design and iterate responsive email templates for lifecycle, promo, and partner (FFGA) sends.
* Keep templates consistent with the design system: icons, logo lockups, buttons, and spacing.

### **Collateral design**

* Build BD and partner decks, including reusable base templates that partner-specific versions fork from.
* Produce sales enablement materials and co-branded partner assets (e.g., FFGA x Granted), plus a self-serve asset library reps and HR teams can pull from.
* Turn around one-off brand and marketing design requests as they come in.

### **Social-first video editing**

* Cut UGC and talking-head ads into multiple lengths (e.g., 15s and 30s) and aspect ratios (9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9) for Meta and YouTube.
* Burn in captions, add B-roll and text reveals, and keep the edit moving so it holds retention through the hook.
* Version and riff winning ads: new hooks, on-screen insurer callouts, swapped presenters (including AI-generated), and platform re-cuts from existing masters.
* Build light motion graphics and AI-assisted animation, such as product and explainer sequences (e.g., a bill-scan animation).

**You'll Bring**
----------------

### **Must-haves:**

* 3+ years in production or creative design, with a portfolio spanning web, email, and static work.
* Proficiency in Figma for landing pages and web layouts.
* Responsive email design in an ESP (Klaviyo, Customer.io, or similar).
* Comfort designing to an existing brand system and holding output consistent across formats.
* Fast, reliable turnaround on high volume; you can read a written brief and run with it.

### **Nice-to-haves:**

* Social-first video editing in Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, or equivalent — captioning, resizing, and fast multi-cut delivery.
* Motion graphics or AI-assisted animation experience.

### **Toolkit:**

Figma, Adobe Premiere and After Effects (or CapCut), an ESP for email (Klaviyo or Customer.io), Canva, Linear for briefs and tickets, Slack, and Notion.

**You'll Thrive Here If**
-------------------------

* You get energy from taking a rough brief and shipping the finished thing — the ad cut, the landing page, the email — not just art-directing it
* You move fast without dropping the details: multiple versions a week, every one on-brand and within the compliance rules
* You like variety and don’t need to own one polished flagship — you’d rather turn around video, web, email, and decks and see what actually performs
* You care about the same problem Granted is solving — helping people who are stressed and overwhelmed feel like someone’s actually on their side

Compensation Range: $100K - $160K

jobs.title: Product Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the company**

Jay Franco is a New York-based licensed home textile company. We design and develop bedding, bath, and home products featuring brands like Disney, Marvel, Star Wars, LEGO, and Minecraft, and we sell them to major U.S. retailers including Walmart and Target. Every product starts as artwork and a spec sheet and ends up on a store shelf — and the Product Development Coordinator is the person who keeps dozens of those products moving between our design team, our overseas agents and factories, testing labs, licensors, and retailers, without a detail getting lost on the way.

**What you'll own**

You'll run 20+ active product programs at a time — more in peak season. For each one, you are the single source of truth: you write and send the daily project emails that tell agents and factories exactly what's needed (timelines, specs, colors, sizing, fabrication, sample requests, testing, changes), you evaluate every sample that comes back, and you chase down whatever is holding a program up — whether that's artwork, packaging, a lab test, a licensor approval, or a factory date. When a program ships on time and right, it's because you caught the wrong Pantone, the missing size, or the expired test before it became a problem.

**Who this is for**

This role is open to someone early in their career or someone with a few years of product development, sourcing, merchandising, or production coordination behind them. A background in textiles, apparel, home goods, or fashion is a real plus (a degree in textile, fashion merchandising, or product development counts). What we can't teach is the mindset: you notice small things — a color that's slightly off, a measurement that doesn't match the spec, a date that moved in one email but not another — and you can't leave them alone. You write clear, complete emails that someone overseas can act on without a follow-up question. You keep your own tracker, you know where every sample is, and you raise a problem the day you see it, not the day it's due.

**Who this isn't for — please read before applying**

Be honest with yourself about these points:

* This is a high-volume, detail-heavy coordination job. Most of your day is email, spreadsheets, spec sheets, and samples. If you're looking for a mainly creative or design role, this isn't it.
* You will manage 20+ programs at once, and in peak season more. Priorities shift daily based on factory responses, retailer requests, and sales meetings. If juggling many open threads at the same time stresses you out, this role will too.
* Accuracy is the job. A wrong color code or size in one email can mean a re-sample, a missed retailer date, or a failed test. "Close enough" is not a standard we can work with.
* Our factories and agents are overseas, so the overnight replies are waiting for you every morning and need clear answers fast.
* This is fully onsite in our New York City office, five days a week.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* **Daily project communication:** Prepare and maintain a detailed email summary for every assigned program, clearly documenting timelines, required actions, consumer testing, sample requests, product specifications, color details, sizing, fabrications, and factory change requests for agents and factories.
* **Program management:** Manage 20+ active projects daily (volume varies by season), keeping every piece of information accurate, current, and sent on time.
* **Sample evaluation:** Review every incoming sample for design execution, color, sizing, fabrication, construction, quality, and adherence to product specifications.
* **Sample control:** Organize, track, and clearly label all samples through development so they can be found and used the moment they're needed.
* **Sample expediting:** Coordinate and expedite samples for sales meetings, presentations, retailer reviews, and other key milestones.
* **Cross-functional partnership:** Keep programs on schedule with internal teams and external partners:
* Art Department — transfer and upload artwork to factories for development, and keep artwork files organized and accessible.
* Packaging Design — confirm packaging is accurate, approved, and aligned with product specs and retailer requirements.
* Director of Product Integrity — make sure products go to the correct retailer-designated testing lab and follow all required testing protocols.
* Production — confirm that factory ship dates and production timelines in your daily communications are accurate and current.
* **Project resources:** Give the Art Department and overseas teams links to current artwork, spec sheets, and development documents — always the latest version.
* **Artwork review:** Check artwork before it goes to factories, flagging color limitations, production restrictions, or anything else that could affect development or final production.
* **Prototypes and color standards:** Coordinate prototypes and color standards with factories so products meet design and quality expectations.
* **Document accuracy:** Review purchase orders, production forms, and related documents for accuracy against approved specifications.
* **Deadline ownership:** Own every program's deadlines and requirements — licensor approvals, retailer requirements, testing, sampling, and development milestones — and make sure each is completed correctly and on time.
* **Problem-solving:** Spot issues early, raise them immediately, and work with the right teams to fix them and keep the program on track.
* **General support:** Assist with sample reviews, meetings, project organization, and other product development tasks as requested.

**Qualifications**

* 0–3+ years in product development, sourcing, merchandising, production, or a related coordination role. Entry-level candidates with relevant internships or coursework are welcome.
* Textile, apparel, home goods, or fashion industry experience strongly preferred; a degree in textiles, fashion merchandising, product development, or a related
