jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, Midmarket
jobs.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Sales Development Representative to help build and scale our outbound motion into the mid-market segment at Steer, multi-location, full service auto repair groups operating 4 or more rooftops. This role is focused on uncovering and developing opportunities with growing repair groups, engaging multiple stakeholders across an organization, and guiding prospects through a longer, more consultative sales process than a typical single-shop deal.

This is not a passive, inbound role. You will be expected to create opportunities from scratch, navigate multi-location organizations with more than one decision-maker, and develop messaging that resonates with owners and operators managing growing, complex businesses. We are looking for someone who is no stranger to overcoming obstacles, comfortable with longer sales cycles, and strives to exceed expectations. Come join a team where skill cultivation, career advancement, and talent retention are core values.

  

*This is a fully remote role for US-based candidates.*

*Compensation: 65k base + 25-35k variable* ***(90-100k OTE)***

  

**You Are**

* A Self-Starter: You are intrinsically motivated, results-oriented, and comfortable operating in a high-volume, outbound-heavy environment.
* Empathetic & Professional: You are approachable and professional, with a genuine desire to help business owners and operators achieve their goals.
* Resilient & Persistent: You maintain a positive attitude in the face of rejection, using setbacks as opportunities for growth and learning.
* A Strong Communicator: You possess a growth mindset and are self-assured in your ability to build rapport across multiple stakeholders and engage in compelling, effective communication.
* Organized & Disciplined: You are dependable and consistent in meeting deadlines and managing your pipeline activity, including longer, multi-touch sales cycles.
* Coachable: You are enthusiastic, open to feedback, and committed to continuous improvement.

  

**You Will**

* Drive Outbound Growth: Conduct a high volume of calls and outreach to identify and engage decision-makers and economic buyers at multi-location auto repair groups.
* Navigate Complex Organizations: Identify and build relationships with multiple stakeholders within a single account, from individual shop leadership to regional or ownership-level decision-makers.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative Terminal Tractor
jobs.description:
The **Sales Development Representative, Terminal Tractor** is responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence within an assigned territory. This position develops new business opportunities, builds and maintains strategic customer relationships, and serves as the primary sales representative for terminal tractor products and related solutions, including equipment sales, rentals, parts, service, and body shop support.

**Rush Truck Centers** opens the door to the world of opportunity. We are the largest network of commercial vehicle dealerships across the US representing truck and bus manufacturers. Our franchises include Peterbilt, International, Hino, Isuzu, Ford, IC Bus and Blue Bird. We offer a **rewarding career** as a leader in the transportation industry. **Grow with us** as we continue to expand our network of locations and services.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Develop and execute territory sales plans to generate new business opportunities, expand assigned account penetration, and increase terminal tractor market share.
* Identify, pursue, and secure sales opportunities through prospecting, customer engagement, relationship building, and strategic account management.
* Serve as the primary customer contact for terminal tractor solutions, including equipment sales, rentals, parts, service, maintenance, and body shop support.
* Drive aftermarket revenue growth by promoting parts, service, maintenance, and rental offerings that support customer retention and long-term account value.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with transportation, distribution, warehousing, intermodal, manufacturing, and related industry customers.
* Collaborate with sales, service, parts, rental, and operations teams to coordinate customer solutions and support a consistent customer experience.
* Monitor market conditions, customer needs, competitive activity, and industry trends to identify growth opportunities and support business development strategies.
* Achieve or exceed established sales, revenue, profitability, customer growth, pipeline management, and activity reporting objectives.

**Education and/or Experience**

  

* High school diploma or GED required; Associate's degree or Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, Transportation, Logistics, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 3 to 5 years of successful B2B sales, business development, equipment sales, transportation sales, or related industry experience, with a demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales, revenue, and customer growth objectives.
* Experience selling commercial vehicles, terminal tractors, material handling equipment, heavy equipment, fleet solutions, transportation services, or industrial products, including generating new business through prospecting, networking, cold calling, and relationship management.
* Must possess a current and valid driver's license with a driving record that meets the insurability guidelines set forth by the company’s insurance carrier.

**Other Skills and Abilities Required**

* Strong relationship-building and consultative selling skills with the ability to establish credibility and trust with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with General Managers, Truck Sales Managers, Aftermarket Sales Managers, and cross-functional sales teams to execute growth initiatives.
* Proficiency using CRM systems to manage customer accounts, sales pipelines, forecasting, and activity tracking; working knowledge of parts, service, rentals, aftermarket programs, or fleet maintenance operations preferred.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to identify customer needs and recommend comprehensive equipment and aftermarket solutions.
* Ability to analyze market trends, competitive activity, and customer data to identify opportunities and support strategic sales decisions.
* Effective verbal, written, presentation, and negotiation skills with the ability to communicate at all levels of an organization.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines in a dynamic sales environment.
* Ability to prepare and present sales forecasts, territory performance updates, and market intelligence reports to leadership.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented with the ability to work independently while achieving sales and growth objectives.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint, for reporting, analysis, and customer communications.

**Benefits:**

We offer exceptional compensation and benefits, 401K and stock purchase, incentives for performance, training, and opportunity for advancement - all in a culture that appreciates and rewards excellence, a positive attitude and integrity.

Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities/Women/Protected Veterans/Disabled

*This job posting does not state or imply that these are the only duties to be performed by this employee. The employee will be required to follow any other instructions and to perform any other duties requested by their leader.*

jobs.title: Program Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Description**

  
  

Job Overview:

As a Program Operations Specialist for the Business Transformation team, you’ll be responsible for keeping the programs, day-to-day machinery, and planning ecosystem running so that business leaders can focus on managing risks and making decisions. This role supports calendaring, project plan updates, documentation of meeting transcripts and working files, developing AI agent-based reporting, and coordinating cross-functional meetings.

This hybrid position may report to our corporate office in either downtown Chicago, Illinois; Hoffman Estates, Illinois; or Dania Beach, Florida. This role requires monthly travel FirstService Residential corporate offices in the United States and Canada.

Your Responsibilities:

* Schedule and coordinate workstream sessions, steering committees, support the planning and documentation of configuration workshops, and counterpart meetings across four organizations and multiple time zones; hold broad calendar awareness across workstreams and coordinate availability.
* Prepare agendas and pre-reads, confirm attendance and counterparts, manage room and virtual logistics, and distribute follow-ups and draft documents via Co-Pilot and Claude.
* Ensure every working and decision-making meeting is transcribed, and that raw transcripts and summaries land in the designated Teams folder using the agreed naming and folder structure.
* Review transcripts and summaries for decisions, actions and risks; draft entries for the Decisions Log and Risk Log and route them to the owning lead for confirmation; track open actions to closure.
* Maintain the master project plan in Smartsheet with the Program Manager: status updates from pillar leads, date changes, new rows from partner plans, and reconciliation against the pillar action plans; track overdue items and flag conflicts before they reach the weekly report.
* Keep Confluence current as the long-term document repository (design objects, RACI, counterpart matrix, process documentation) and Teams as the collaboration space; maintain the program glossary and distribution lists.
* Support the weekly reporting cycle by assembling inputs and verifying them against the plan and logs.
* Serve as the logistics point of contact across multiple teams and partners, coordinate onboarding, access requests and document exchange (SharePoint/SFTP) for partner staff.
* Support UAT and training logistics as the program moves into build: tester rosters, session scheduling around business blackouts, script and issue-log housekeeping.

Skills & Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, operations management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2 years’ experience in executive administration, project management, operations, or coordinator roles.
* Experience with process mapping tools, workflow automation, and project management methodologies required. Experience with Smartsheet or similar project management tools strongly preferred.
* Works effectively with coworkers, clients, customers, and others by sharing ideas in a constructive and positive manner; addresses problems and issues constructively to find mutually acceptable and practical business solutions.
* Must possess a high energy attitude and an ability to multi-task/prioritize different projects at any given time.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.

What We Offer:

As a full-time associate, you will be eligible for full comprehensive benefits including your choice of multiple medical plans, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, legal, identity theft, and pet insurance. You will also be eligible for company-paid life insurance and benefits from our employee assistance program. In addition, you will be eligible for paid time off, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement, and a 401(k) with company match.

Compensation:

$ 65000 - $ 75,000 / hour

Disclaimer Statement

The above information on this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. This is not an all-inclusive job description; therefore, management has the right to assign or reassign schedules, duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

  
  
**Automated Employment Decision Tool (AEDT) Usage:** We may utilize an Automated Employment Decision Tool (AEDT) in connection with the assessment or evaluation of candidates. The AEDT is designed to assist in objectively evaluating candidate qualifications based on specific job-related characteristics.  
  
**Job Qualifications and Characteristics Assessed:** The AEDT evaluates candidates based on job qualifications and characteristics pertinent to the role, including skills, experience, and competencies relevant to the position requirements. These qualifications are determined by the unique needs of each role within our company.  
  
**Alternative Selection Process or Reasonable Accommodations:** Candidates who require an alternative selection process or a “reasonable accommodation,” as defined under applicable disability laws, may make a request through our designated contact channel national\_recruiting@fsresidential.com.

new_jobs.title: Graduate Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
This position will provide a broad range of high-level administrative services for School of Communication PhD and MS programs. Working with the Graduate Program Director, Dean, Asst Deans, faculty and staff, plan, coordinate and oversee day-to-day program operational activities. Perform other duties as assigned.  
  
Chapman University’s mission is centered on serving our students and strengthening our campus community. Chapman believes there is significant value in an in-person workforce. Being present fosters collaboration, strengthens relationships across departments, enables us to better serve our co-workers and contributes to the student experience. It is an important part of the culture that makes Chapman a special place to work and learn.

Responsibilities

* Coordinate and provide administrative assistance to the School of Communication graduate programs, faculty, and students
* Work collaboratively with the Graduate Program Director, Asst Deans, and Undergraduate Program Coordinator in development of class schedules, taking faculty load into account; input and maintain class schedules. Collaborate with Graduate Director/Chair on semester course scheduling and assist with graduate student registration process and orientation
* Assist the Graduate Program Director with student enrollment, Assigning Advisors in PeopleSoft, and Permission Numbers.
* Assist the Graduate Program Director with graduate student registration process and orientation
* Work collaboratively with faculty in reviewing, editing, and processing graduate course and catalog changes annually.
* Assist Faculty and Undergraduate Program Coordinator with hiring, and managing on-boarding, of new full-time and part-time faculty
* Generate graduate faculty contracts
* Coordinate with SMC for graduate program advertising
* Manage purchasing, ordering and reimbursements for Graduate program specific needs
* Coordinate room needs for Graduate program faculty and staff
* Serve as liaison with the Office of Graduate Admissions and the Office of Graduate Education
* Manage the hiring process for SOC graduate students (GShip); generate GSI (Graduate Student Instructor) contracts and GRA (Grad Research Assistant) paperwork, interfacing with VPGE (Vice Provost for Graduate Education) and HR as necessary and troubleshooting any problems
* Work collaboratively with the Graduate Director/Chair and faculty to manage graduate student thesis projects, completion of forms, faculty committee members, thesis defenses, degree completion protocols
* Assist with MS and PhD admission process and recruiting (Tracking admissions applications, coordinating information sessions, and communicating with applicants and potential applicants.)
* Review SOC graduate student scholarly and creative activity, grant awards, routing student applications to appropriate faculty and assuring timely review submission
* Assist MS and PhD students with travel for university business needs
* Manage payments, reimbursements, etc. for Grad faculty and students
* Disseminate program information and respond to inquiries from prospective students
* Work with current graduate students to answer program-related questions and concerns
* Serve as college staff rep for the university-wide events for graduate students
* As a member of the college staff team, assist with college-wide and department activities
* Serve as backup to other support positions as needed
* Some travel and weekend work hours are required.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination in education and experience.
* 2-3 years of related working experience
* Demonstrated effective oral and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills
* Proven ability to exercise independent thinking and judgment to carry out duties in a timely manner.
* Ability to exercise initiative and work independently and as a team member.
* Experience in providing administrative support in a professional office.
* Demonstrated ability to use tact and diplomacy and to maintain a high level of confidentiality.
* Proven ability to prioritize duties when faced with interruptions, distractions, and fluctuating workload.
* Proficient knowledge and skill in Microsoft Office Suite applications.
* Ability to learn in-house software

Desired Qualifications

* Master’s degree in related field.
* Experience in admission and recruiting.
* Working knowledge of university software, policies, and procedures

Special Instructions to Applicants

At Chapman University, we believe collaboration thrives through in-person engagement. This position is fully on campus, and employees work alongside colleagues, faculty, students, and staff each day to support our vibrant university community.

new_jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
SUMMARY  
The Senior Marketing Coordinator develops messages for print and digital forms of marketing, and copyedits content written by self and other members of the Marketing Department team. The incumbent handles daily administrative approval items in customer relationship management (CRM) and timekeeping platforms, and supports marketing campaign/project enhancements and communications for the Marketing department.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.  

* Write messages through various content types including print collateral, website content, brochures, publications, product descriptions, press releases, announcements, and other forms of marketing.
* Copyedit content written by self and team members for spelling, grammar, syntax, and punctuation to ensure accuracy and brand consistency. Work closely with designers and marketing team members to update and amend written content according to feedback.
* Conduct research, monitor marketing trends and support competitive marketing campaigns.
* Maintain marketing database and photo library, and filing systems for paper and electronic documents.
* Fulfill administrative tasks such as sample order entry, and maintaining marketing documents and resource materials related marketing and communication activities.
* Handles daily administrative approval items in Salesforce CRM platform (e.g., sample order entry, Co-op credit, purchase requisitions, check requests, trip reports, IRAs), and timekeeping platform.
* Provide marketing project and tradeshow support.
* Provide customer service and sales support as needed.
* Exercise judgment to balance priorities and communicate to teams to meet and exceed project deadlines and commitments; keep the marketing team informed of projects and progress.
* Assist with special projects and other job-related duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES  
This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE  
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Journalism, Communications, or Public Relations AND 3 years of related experience, OR equivalent combination of education, training and experience.  
Prior experience in corporate content creation, Social Media, and other creative content development is a plus.

COMPUTER SKILLS  
Possess intermediate knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook) and proficiency with PC and Mac platforms and tools. Basic knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator) is a plus, but not necessary.

LANGUAGE SKILLS  
Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of the organization. The ability to present ideas effectively using both oral and written skills. Ability to communicate effectively with customers, vendors, and co-workers.

new_jobs.description:
Veregy is an award-winning NAESCO-Accredited decarbonization company focusing on accelerating and simplifying Energy Transition. We provide turnkey engineering and construction services designed to reduce our clients' energy and operating costs through the implementation of energy efficiency and infrastructure upgrades, smart building technology, fleet EV infrastructure, clean energy generation, and sustainability.  
  
Do you want to be part of a TEAM who delivers Eco-Friendly Environments that Transform Lives? Then you are in the right place…start the application process today!

**Summary of Position Functions**  
  
The Construction Project Coordinator undertakes and performs a variety of support tasks and assignments to support office and field work performed by one or more Project Managers, Senior Project Managers and/or others as assigned. Acts as a liaison between Field employees and Accounting.

**Essential Position Functions**

* Transitions preconstruction projects to implementation projects.
* Enters all project related data into Viewpoint (by Vista) (budgets, contract amounts, schedule of values, etc).
* Requests performance and payment bonds, certificates of insurance (and renewals), and day preliminary notices, as applicable and tracks and follows up as required.
* Assists in developing the project schedule of values and enters into Viewpoint and/or client’s billing format.
* Assists in preparing monthly billings and lien waivers, where required, and projecting project billings.
* Updates monthly billing information in Viewpoint and billing information into bond log, monthly.
* Follows-up on accounts receivables and coordinates receipts with the accounting department.
* Prepares subcontract agreements and purchase agreements and submits to subcontractor and/or vendor for execution.

* Responds to subcontractor/vendor preliminary notices.
* Assists with the preparation and tracking of submittals and, maintains submittal/equipment log.
* Sends tax privilege exempt and related financial documents to general contractors.
* Prepares project specific badges, badge logs and coordinates updates with the superintendent.
* Prepares O&M manuals and various close-out documents at completion of project.
* Manages compliance with federal and CA laws including CA Department of Industrial Relations and Davis Bacon prevailing wage regulations.

* Other duties as assigned.

* None.

* High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or two to five years’ related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Two years of project assistance, project coordination, administrative assistant or closely related experience in commercial construction, HVAC, or related field required.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Knowledge of Veregy’s services and processes is required which can be obtained through intellect, technical inclination, and dedication to gain such knowledge.
* Knowledge of the principles of file and records management and the basic principles of bookkeeping and/or accounting
* Knowledge (Intermediate to advanced) of various operating systems, software products (e.g. MS Office, etc.), is required.
* Ability to work independently and efficiently manage time / workload.
* Ability to simultaneously manage multiple projects with overlapping deadlines, deliverables, and other requirements.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relations with co-workers, vendors, customers, and the general public.
* Ability to effectively respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers and staff.
* Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and tactfully negotiate priority with end users.
* Ability to work under deadline pressure and extra hours if needed.

* Professional certification such as CFA/CPA a plus.

This role is pivotal in growing an assigned portfolio of customers, ensuring exceptional service, and driving sales of specialty branded merchandise, such as embroidered polo shirts, jackets, and other products. The ideal candidate will possess strong interpersonal skills, organizational abilities, and a proactive approach to building relationships with both existing and prospective customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Provide concierge-level customer service to ensure an exceptional experience.
* Respond to customer and internal queries promptly, aiming for a 24-hour turnaround time.
* Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude with customers and team members.
* Address and resolve customer complaints effectively and efficiently.
* Build and nurture long-term relationships with customers through open and proactive communication.

**Sales & Account Management**

* Drive growth and profitability for assigned accounts through upselling, cross-selling, and retention strategies.
* Identify and pursue new customer opportunities, leveraging leads within 24 hours of receipt.
* Develop and execute marketing and sales strategies to meet personal and team sales targets.
* Provide quotes and customized solutions to customers within field authority pricing guidelines.
* Foster collaboration with plant teams to maximize sales opportunities.

**Operational Support**

* Set up and maintain customer accounts, including online stores, pricing, and product options.
* Train customers on using online web stores and encourage adoption of automated systems.
* Process orders, modifications, and payments in a timely and accurate manner (within 24-48 hours).
* Collaborate with internal departments and external decorators to ensure seamless execution of customer requests.
* Create and manage artwork proofs, mock-ups, and custom designs for customer review and approval.
* Prepare reports and maintain accurate customer records in systems such as Uniform Market/Seller’s Commerce, NetSuite, Shipworks and ABS.

* Generate invoices and collect payments for orders.
* Follow up on past-due invoices and achieve monthly accounts receivable goals.
* Address and resolve billing inquiries professionally and efficiently.

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent; additional education is a plus.
* Proven customer service experience, with the ability to handle challenging situations calmly.
* Strong computer literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Office and other software.

**Preferred Skills**

* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Attention to detail and a focus on delivering quality.
* Experience with programs such as NetSuite, ABS, and supplier portals is a plus.
* Experience working in a spreadsheet environment (Microsoft Excel)

**Programs Used**

* ABS, Bi-Launch, Microsoft Office, NetSuite, Outlook, Penn Emblem Portal, Shipworks, Uniform Market/Seller’s Commerce, and other supplier portals.

* A dynamic work environment with a collaborative and supportive team culture.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Comprehensive training on our products, systems, and processes.

If you are a detail-oriented professional with a passion for customer service and sales, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Help us grow our direct sales channel while making a meaningful impact on our customers’ businesses.

* Exceptional Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Paid Time Off for vacation and sick time

* Paid Life Insurance

new_jobs.title: Client Relationship Manager
new_jobs.description:
***About Valligent***

Valligent, a Veros Software company, is a leading provider of technology-enabled real estate valuation solutions. The company delivers innovative appraisal, property inspection, and valuation services that help lenders, investors, and mortgage professionals make faster, more informed decisions while improving accuracy, compliance, and the borrower experience. Founded in 2003, Valligent combines industry expertise with advanced technology to modernize the property valuation process.

***Job Summary***

Valligent is looking for a Client Relationship Manager to help strengthen relationships with existing clients, support new client on boarding, and identify opportunities to better serve our clients with the right products and solutions. This role reports to the VP of Operations and works closely with Sales, Operations, clients, and prospective clients. The right person is a strong communicator, highly organized, client-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where follow-through and professionalism matter. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, supporting business growth, and creating an excellent client experience.

***What You’ll Do***

As the Client Relationship Manager, you will serve as a key point of contact for clients and internal teams. You will help ensure clients receive timely communication, thoughtful support, and solutions that align with their needs.

Key responsibilities include:

* Build and maintain strong relationships with current clients, prospective clients, and client contacts
* Support the Sales team by helping identify client needs, product opportunities, and service solutions
* Provide a high-quality client experience through clear communication, attention to detail, and reliable follow-through
* Assist with onboarding new clients and helping them understand Valligent’s products, services, and communication processes
* Learn and understand Valligent’s product offerings to recommend solutions that fit each client’s needs
* Monitor client reporting, turn times, and service-level expectations to help ensure client satisfaction
* Communicate client feedback, needs, and opportunities to Sales, Operations, and leadership
* Proactively identify issues and help resolve client concerns in a professional and timely manner
* Escalate sensitive or high-priority situations to executive management when appropriate
* Understand order workflows within the client management system
* Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when handling client and company information

***What We’re Looking For***

We are looking for someone who is professional, proactive, and comfortable communicating with clients and internal team members. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, dependable, and able to manage multiple priorities while keeping the client experience front and center.

**Qualified candidates should have:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong customer service or client relationship skills
* Good judgment and the ability to make thoughtful decisions that support both the client and the business
* Strong organization, planning, and follow-through
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating with Sales, Operations, and leadership
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment when handling confidential information
* Proficiency with communication tools such as Microsoft Teams, GoTo Meeting, or similar platforms
* Ability to learn client management systems and order workflows
* Typing speed of at least 45 words per minute

***Preferred Experience***  
  
The following experience is helpful but not required:

* Client success, account management, sales support, or customer service experience
* Experience in real estate valuation, appraisal, and mortgage related fields
* Experience working with client reporting, service-level agreements, or operational workflows

***Why Join Valligent?***

At Valligent, you’ll be part of a team focused on providing modern valuation solutions, strong client service, and reliable operational support. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, contribute to company growth, and play an important part in delivering a strong customer experience. If you are a strong communicator who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and helping clients succeed, we’d like to hear from you.

**Additional Information**

We offer a unique opportunity that encourages innovation and growth along with benefits that include medical, dental, vision, 401K, life, PTO, holidays and more.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

new_jobs.title: Sales Representative I
new_jobs.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

The Sales Representative I reports to the Sales Team Lead and promotes and sells Zimmer Biomet orthopedic products, including implants, surgical tools, and ZBEdge technologies, to healthcare professionals and facilities. This role builds upon foundational clinical and sales experience to contribute more strategically to account planning, surgeon engagement, and business growth. The Sales Rep I demonstrates increasing independence in selling, clinical support, and collaboration while mentoring less experienced team members and participating in cross-functional initiatives. This role represents the first step in a performance-driven sales career path.

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------

**Strategic Selling Focused**  

* Assists in building and implementing account plans for assigned area.
* Manages and tracks customer sales activity and prospective customer initiatives.
* Manages sales funnel and activities for sales targets and reports on sales progress.
* Monitors and reports competitor and customer activities to sales team lead.
* Utilizes the surgery management system (SMS) to ensure flawless execution of product delivery to the customer.
* Develops and maintains strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, operating room staff, and hospital administrators to support account development and sales growth.
* Provides outstanding customer service by identifying buying signals, gathering competitive intelligence, and exploring upsell and cross-sell opportunities in existing accounts.
* Analyzes territory and surgeon-level sales data to support strategic account planning, targeting, and competitive positioning efforts.
* Dedicates 20–30% of time to acquiring new business or expanding existing accounts through targeted surgeon and account outreach.
* Collaborate with internal teams including marketing, customer service, and logistics to support account and customer needs.
* Plans, coordinates, and executes local educational and sales events with support from internal or corporate resources to increase brand presence and achieve sales objectives.

**Case Coverage and Clinical Focus**  

* Actively develops clinical expertise through exposure to complex cases and high-stakes procedures, while delivering advanced technical support during surgeries, demonstrations, and product evaluations.
* Acts as a product expert by delivering technical support during surgical procedures, live demonstrations, and clinical evaluations.
* Attends and supports surgical cases while demonstrating knowledge of Zimmer Biomet implants, instrumentation, and surgical workflows.

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Graduate Funding Unit plays a central role in maintaining the highest level of academic excellence possible at UC Berkeley. We provide fellowships, funding, and program support to attract the most competitive students to our university and provide funding opportunities for students at various stages of their academic career. Our programs exist to give students opportunities to devote themselves fully to the pursuit of their scholarly and professional interests. Our knowledge and expertise in all areas of graduate funding and student life provide a strong foundation for advising the students, faculty, and staff across our vast and diverse campus.
  
  
The Student Funding team trains and advises staff and faculty departmental advisors in over 125 degree programs, offers direct advising to approximately 13,000 graduate and professional students, as well as individuals seeking admission into a graduate program at Berkeley. Training and expertise includes fellowship and academic support funding and collective bargaining agreement administration for academic student employees and graduate student researchers.

The Fellowships Program Coordinator plays a significant role in supporting graduate students through the administration of Graduate Division, Campus, National, and International fellowship programs on behalf of the campus. This position works with internal and external organizations to coordinate graduate student fellowships, providing support to students, faculty, and staff from application to evaluation to awarding. The Fellowships Program Coordinator serves as an expert resource to update formulas and eligibility requirements according to national and constituent regulations and policies, ensuring proper payment of awards and monitoring compliance with fellowship terms. Additionally, this position administers and tracks the current University Fellowship allocation system, analyzes data to ensure compliance and accurate aid delivery, and partners with departmental staff to provide accurate and transparent information about funding to help students achieve their academic goals.

The First Review Date for this job is October 19, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.

Fellowship Program Administration - 30%

**Administrative Coordinator**

**Job Summary**

The Administrative Coordinator oversees daily office administration and coordinates fire sprinkler, fire alarm, fire extinguisher, and suppression system service, inspection, and installation projects. This position manages technician scheduling, customer communication, billing, project documentation, and administrative compliance tracking.

Serving as a central point of contact for customers, technicians, dispatchers, vendors, sales, design, and management, the Administrative Coordinator helps ensure work is completed efficiently, on time, and in accordance with customer expectations. Success requires strong organizational and leadership skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage changing priorities while providing professional, responsive service.

**Essential Duties**

* Coordinate daily technician schedules and service and inspection appointments based on availability, location, technician qualifications, project requirements, and customer needs.

* Plan efficient service routes, prioritize service requests, and promptly coordinate technician response to urgent repairs and emergency calls.

* Monitor work orders, project schedules, and inspection deadlines; follow up on incomplete work and communicate delays or scheduling changes.

* Reassign technicians and adjust resources to accommodate changing priorities, emergency calls, and last-minute scheduling changes.

* Communicate with local fire marshals regarding scheduling, permits, inspection documentation, and compliance inquiries; refer technical questions to appropriate personnel.

* Track field service orders, process customer invoices, record project costs, and maintain accurate billing and project records.

* Ensure technicians receive necessary job information, documentation, site access details, and resources before scheduled work.

* Serve as a primary contact and escalation point for commercial property managers and building owners regarding scheduling, project status, service updates, delays, and concerns.

* Prepare and submit fire department permit applications, business license paperwork, and technician certification documentation; monitor expiration dates and coordinate timely renewals to avoid lapses.

* Maintain clear and professional communication with customers throughout the service and project lifecycle to promote customer satisfaction.

* Collect required documentation and compile closeout packages for completed system installations.

* Maintain current customer, work order, and project information in service management systems and provide status updates as needed. Process, log, and distribute official fire alarm, sprinkler, and extinguisher inspection reports.

* Review documentation for completeness and accuracy, coordinate corrections or missing records, and support compliance with applicable state, local, and National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) documentation and reporting requirements.

* Answer phones, handle incoming and outgoing mail, maintain files, order office supplies, and support daily office operations.

* Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement solutions designed to improve scheduling efficiency, project coordination, and customer satisfaction

* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned to support successful project completion and department operations.

Qualifications

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in dispatch, scheduling, project coordination, office administration, or related work; experience in fire protection, construction, HVAC, plumbing, or a similar service industry preferred.

* Project coordination or project management experience is strongly preferred; experience with budgeting, project tracking, and resource allocation preferred.

* Strong organizational, scheduling, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.

* Excellent verbal and written communication and customer service skills, with the ability to maintain positive relationships with customers, technicians, vendors, and team members.

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make timely decisions, work under pressure, and adapt to changing schedules and operational needs.

* High attention to detail and accuracy in billing, inspection reports, permit records, certification tracking, and other documentation that may affect building safety or code compliance.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, including Excel, Outlook, and Teams.

* Proficiency with field service management platforms, such as ServiceTrade, HindSite, or comparable systems.

* Familiarity with fire protection terminology, systems, codes, and standards, including NFPA standards, backflow preventers, and wet and dry sprinkler systems, highly preferred.

* Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

**Education**

* High school diploma or equivalent.

* A combination of relevant education and experience may be substituted for the minimum requirements.

Classification: Non-exempt, In Person, Full Time

Supervisory: None

**HOMELESS CHILDREN’S NETWORK MISSION STATEMENT**

Homeless Children’s Network’s (HCN) mission is to decrease the trauma of homelessness and domestic violence for children, youth, and families; to empower families; and to increase the effectiveness of collaborative efforts among service providers to end homelessness and poverty. Since 1992, HCN has empowered San Francisco’s underserved and historically marginalized communities citywide toward a brighter future with love, wholeness, and healing.

**About Homeless Children’s Network (HCN)**

Since 1992, HCN has been San Francisco’s leading nonprofit agency for comprehensive early intervention and mental health support for underserved and historically marginalized children, youth, and families experiencing homelessness, housing instability, or living in intergenerational poverty. Our mobile therapeutic model is both accessible and scalable, enabling clinicians to meet clients directly in the community. As the hub of a Collaborative of 60+ service agencies and community-based organizations, we serve over 2,500 clients each year, reaching those most reluctant to trust conventional mental health systems. Central to our work is our Afri-centric mental health and wellness model. This community-defined approach addresses health inequities and the persistent cycle of racism and trauma over generations. This model not only uplifts the Black/African American communities but also strengthens the behavioral health outcomes of all San Franciscans, fostering resilience, healing, and lasting change.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

HCN is seeking a hands-on Temporary Development Coordinator to support our development team through a busy season. Over the next three months, this role will help deliver events, support our year-end giving campaign, and assist with development and grants operations while team members are out.

This is a great fit for an organized, flexible fundraising professional who can step in quickly, juggle deadlines, and work well with a small, mission-driven team.

* Support logistics for event on 10/27, Thanksgiving Drive, and Holiday Drive

* Support online auction implementation

* Support event materials such as invitations, programs, signage and slides

* Coordinate volunteers; staff events on the days

* Handle post-event follow-up: thank-yous, gift entry and a short wrap-up report

**Year-end giving campaign (approx. 20%)**

* Support Development Associate with production and mailing of the year-end appeal

* Support Giving Tuesday and December giving activities

**Development operations and coverage (approx. 20%)**

* Assist Development Associate with Database Management

* Prepare timely acknowledgment letters and tax receipts

* Cover routine tasks as needed

* Update welcome series for newsletter and volunteer sign ups

* Update thank you letters

* Maintain shared trackers, calendars and files

**Grant support (approx. 20%)**

* Support Associate Development Director with grants as needed, including gathering attachments, budgets and required documents for proposals and reports

* Update the grants calendar and track deadlines and submission confirmations for the Associate Development Director, Grants

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

* 2+ years of nonprofit fundraising, event coordination or development operations experience
* Experience planning or supporting fundraising events from start to finish
* Strong organization and the ability to manage several deadlines at once
* Clear, professional writing and attention to detail
* Experience with a donor database (such as Raiser's Edge, Salesforce, Bloomerang or DonorPerfect)
* Comfort with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace
* Available for occasional evening and weekend work around events
* Able to start quickly and work independently with limited onboarding

**Preferred**

* Experience with year-end or direct mail appeals

* Experience with email marketing tools (such as Mailchimp or Constant Contact)
* Knowledge of or commitment to serving children and families experiencing homelessness

**HCN’s Community Culture**

*Of all the above important qualifications, bring the heartfelt quality of compassion, with exquisite cultural responsiveness as a primary guiding quality, not only of your professional life, but of what you hold dear.*

*Please bring a strong analysis of how race, ethnicity, culture, language, region, poverty, sexual and gender identity, age, education, opportunities and resources generationally made available or not, and systemic oppressions impact a person’s mental health.*

new_jobs.title: Business Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
About Integrity Landscape Management

Integrity Landscape Management supports a growing group of operating companies serving commercial and institutional clients across the San Francisco Bay Area. Our Enterprise Systems & Technology team connects business operations, systems, BI, and process discipline so teams can scale with clearer workflows, stronger controls, and better information.

About the Role

Integrity Landscape Management is seeking a Business Operations Specialist to join our Enterprise Systems & Technology team. This hands-on role sits at the intersection of business operations, enterprise systems, process improvement, and implementation.

You will help ensure recurring operational processes are clearly defined, documented, coordinated, and completed consistently across our operating companies. The work includes ERP-enabled workflows, billing and month-end readiness, implementation support, documentation, training, issue follow-up, and business changes such as new contracts and integrations.

We are looking for someone who can take a business objective, organize the work, coordinate the people involved, work comfortably within ERP and business systems, track open items, and follow through until completion.

What You'll Do

· Own and coordinate assigned recurring business processes, including deadlines, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and completion.

· Gather business requirements and translate them into practical workflows, ownership structures, documentation, and implementation steps.

· Coordinate operational workflows within ERP and other business applications, including contracts, properties, recurring services, work tickets, billing readiness, payroll preparation, month-end activities, and related processes.

· Support system and process implementations through requirements gathering, testing/UAT, rollout, training, issue tracking, stabilization, and follow-up.

· Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, process maps, ownership records, implementation trackers, recurring calendars, and training materials.

· Identify incomplete, inaccurate, or overdue items; organize owners and next steps and follow through until resolution.

· Work cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, branch teams, managers, and other business functions across multiple operating companies.

· Partner with reporting and analytics resources to improve the quality, consistency, and readiness of operational data used for recurring reporting and decision-making.

What We're Looking For

· 5+ years of experience in business operations, business systems support, process ownership, implementation/project coordination, or a similar cross-functional role.

· Strong ownership and follow-through; able to move work from assignment through completion without constant direction.

· Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines, stakeholders, handoffs, recurring cycles, and open items.

· Comfortable learning and working within ERP systems and other business applications.

· Ability to create clear, practical SOPs, checklists, process maps, documentation, and training materials.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills and comfort working with both field-based and corporate teams.

· Strong Excel and general data literacy, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, filtering, reconciliation, and recurring operational files.

· Ability to work independently once objectives, priorities, and boundaries have been established.

· Ability to work periodically from the Richmond office and other Bay Area company locations as business needs require.

Preferred Experience

· Field services, landscaping, facilities, construction services, property services, logistics, or another multi-location service organization.

· ERP or business systems experience; Aspire experience is a plus.

· System implementations, UAT/testing, training, or rollout activities.

· Power BI, SharePoint, Power Automate, or similar business tools.

· Multi-company or multi-branch operating environments.

Who Will Succeed in This Role

This role is well suited for a systems-comfortable operator: someone who understands business operations, learns technology quickly, brings structure to processes that are not always perfectly documented, and follows through across multiple stakeholders. You should be comfortable moving between process design and practical execution - documenting a workflow one day, supporting testing or training the next, and helping resolve an operational exception when a deadline is approaching.

This is not primarily an administrative assistant, IT help desk, software engineering, BI/dashboard development, or strategy-only role. Success requires both coordination and execution: organizing the work, maintaining the process, following through on open items, and helping ensure the operation closes the loop.

What Success Looks Like

· Open items and exceptions are surfaced early and followed through to closure.

· System and process changes move through testing, rollout, training, and stabilization in a structured way.

· Cross-functional teams have clearer handoffs and fewer missed steps.

· Business data is more complete and reliable at billing, payroll, and month-end deadlines.

new_jobs.description:
Posting Description:

**Surety Account Manager II**

Are you a surety professional who thrives at the intersection of client service, underwriting strategy, and operational execution? Join a high-performing team and take on a meaningful role managing and delivering surety bond solutions for many clients.

*This role is hybrid and can be located near an Aon office.*

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**

At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What the day will look like**

You'll work closely with clients, surety carriers, and internal collaborators to deliver bond programs with accuracy, compliance, and outstanding service. This role involves significant client interaction and ownership of key accounts. It offers the chance to create an immediate impact while further developing your expertise in the specialized field of surety.

  

* Works under minimal supervision, exercising good judgment in routine and moderately complex client and market situations.
* Takes primary accountability in managing selected accounts.
* Possesses a working knowledge of surety bonds, including bond program structures, indemnity concepts, and market practices including accurate client interaction and advisement.
* May assist in onboarding, mentoring, and training internal team.
* Works closely with carriers every day to address evolving needs. Prepares and processes various surety instruments, such as bid, final, miscellaneous, and court bonds. Ensures these align with underwriting guidelines and client expectations.
* Collaborates with clients daily to meet their changing requirements. Implements Consents of Surety, Prequalification Letters, Riders, and other obligations required by clients in line with State rules. Determines the necessary documents to complete issuance, including power-of-attorney, resident license, and others, ensuring attention to contractual, legal, and financial details.
* Prepares General Indemnity Agreements and bond applications. Coordinates with and advises clients to acquire complete, accurate financial and corporate information for underwriting review. This includes any other nuanced client needs or requirements.
* Maintains and supports data accuracy and promotes proactive oversight of bond programs in AonBondLink (ABL).

* Manages countersignature requirements and related jurisdictional nuances to support compliant bond issuance across multiple states and territories.
* Provides technical surety mentorship and support to non-surety colleagues, helping interpret bond forms, indemnity requirements, and program structures for internal collaborators.
* Coordinates receipt and organization of pertinent client related underwriting information (e.g., financial statements, work-in-progress schedules, bank information, organizational documents) to support timely carrier decisions.
* Verifies that all bonds are issued within established surety lines of credit and brokerage authority. Assists in structuring and negotiating approvals for bond requests exceeding standard limits or outside delegated authority.

**How this opportunity is different**

Unlike many surety operations roles focused mainly on transaction processing, this position combines technical surety expertise with client advisory duties and meaningful market involvement. You will work directly with complex bonding programs, underwriting negotiations, and carrier relationships while acting as a trusted resource for clients and internal colleagues. The role also allows for broader influence through mentoring, participation in process improvement, and responsibility for critical compliance and underwriting workflows. For professionals wanting to move beyond administrative bond issuance and act as a strategic partner in the surety process, this is an outstanding chance to increase visibility, expand impact, and grow within a leading organization.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  

* Is able to effectively interpret a variety of technical instructions involving abstract and concrete variables and apply them to client and bond-specific scenarios.
* Shows excellent organizational, time-management, and multi-tasking abilities, successfully managing various client and market requirements.
* Retains Notary Public certification.
* Maintains Power of Attorney appointments with major surety markets and exercises such authority responsibly and in accordance with internal controls.
* Is proficient in all required technology platforms, including AonBondLink, Bridge, and Outlook. Uses them to facilitate deliverables for clients and with markets around exposures, new bond needs, changes, expirations, or similar.

**Education and licensing requirements:**

* A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred for this position. Maintain Notary Public designation and hold the appropriate Producer license.

**How we support our colleagues**

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

The Customer Success and Solution Adoption Specialist will serve as the primary functional customer-facing resource for casino management system customers in the United States. The role is responsible for helping customers understand, adopt, and gain value from the system through pre-sales support, product demonstrations, user training, go-live guidance, adoption follow-up, and customer satisfaction tracking.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support pre-sales activities by preparing and delivering functional product demonstrations, explaining casino management system workflows, and responding to customer questions from an operational and business-user perspective.
* Act as a functional power user of the casino management system, with strong knowledge of core workflows such as player management, loyalty, cage, slot/table operations, reporting, and customer-facing operational processes.
* Gather and document customer business requirements, operational pain points, training needs, and adoption risks for review with Asia product, implementation, and technical teams.
* Prepare training materials, user guides, demonstration scripts, quick reference documents, and adoption support materials for casino executives, supervisors, operators, and system users.
* Conduct user training sessions, workshops, and go-live readiness briefings for customer operational teams.
* Support go-live activities by guiding users through system workflows, answering functional questions, tracking user concerns, and coordinating issue follow-up with Technical Operations Specialists.
* Monitor customer adoption after go-live, identify usage gaps, collect feedback, and recommend improvement actions to increase customer satisfaction and solution value.
* Maintain regular customer communication, track customer satisfaction, and escalate adoption risks, customer complaints, or recurring functional issues to the appropriate internal teams.
* Contribute to customer success reporting, including training completion, adoption progress, customer feedback, open issues, and follow-up actions.
* Support knowledge transfer from Asia teams to U.S. customers and from U.S. customer feedback back to Asia product and management teams.

**Required Qualifications and Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality management, information systems, gaming management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in customer success, implementation support, training, casino operations, hospitality systems, gaming technology, enterprise software, or a related customer-facing role.
* Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and customer relationship skills.
* Ability to learn complex software workflows and explain them clearly to non-technical users.
* Strong documentation skills, including the ability to prepare training guides, process notes, adoption reports, and customer follow-up summaries.
* Ability to work independently with customers while coordinating across remote Asia-based management, product, and technical teams.
* Awareness of casino operational environments, customer service expectations, data sensitivity, and regulated business processes.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Queens, NY 11420

new_jobs.title: Medicare Enrollment Sales Representative II
new_jobs.description:
**About NYC Health + Hospitals**
--------------------------------

  

MetroPlus**Health** provides the highest quality healthcare services to residents of Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens and Staten Island through a comprehensive list of products, including, but not limited to, New York State Medicaid Managed Care, Medicare, Child Health Plus, Exchange, Partnership in Care, MetroPlus Gold, Essential Plan, etc. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of NYC Health + Hospitals, the largest public health system in the United States, MetroPlus**Health**'s network includes over 27,000 primary care providers, specialists and participating clinics. For more than 40 years, MetroPlus**Health** has been committed to building strong relationships with its members and providers.

Purpose of Position:
  
Under varying degrees of supervision, identifies qualified Medicare participants and educates them as to the benefits of selecting MetroPlus as a managed care provider. Achieves predetermined monthly enrollments based on regularly updated goals and objectives, documents consumer contracts, and processes grievances. Moreover, maintains a positive public relations presence within the community, provider agencies, and with city and state regulatory agencies. Additionally, may provide training of and/or supervision to subordinate staff. There are three Assignment Levels
  
within this class of positions; all personnel perform related work.

**Work Shifts**
---------------

  

**9:00 A.M – 5:00 P.M**

**Duties & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

  

Level I
  
Under supervision, performs the following typical tasks:
  
  
1. Implements methods, activities and action plans necessary to achieve daily, weekly and monthly objectives.
  
2. Presents clear and accurate information regarding health plan to eligible recipients and community-at-large.
  
3. Performs group and individual presentations for purpose of educating and enrolling qualified participants in a variety of arenas including but not limited to senior centers, provider sites,
  
churches, assisted living facilities, nursing homes, etc.
  
4. Provides all benefit/service related information to members, applicants, and providers.
  
5. Performs telemarketing activities as appropriate for purposes of enrollment and follow-up activity.
  
6. Processes all member demographic changes.
  
7. Maintains accurate documentation related to enrollment and field activities.
  
8. Participates in regularly scheduled sales/marketing meetings as required.
  
9. Performs other related tasks as directed.

  

Level II
  
Under supervision, with latitude for independent judgment and decision making, performs the work of Assignment Level I at a higher level, and/or the following typical tasks:
  
  
1. May act as preceptor to subordinate Enrollment Sales Representatives to facilitate their understanding of MetroPlus objectives, operations and site specific information.
  
2. Implements and monitors appropriate methods, activities and action plans necessary to regularly achieve accelerated predetermined enrollment objectives.
  
3. Ensures appropriate and accurate documentation of call center plan enrollments and field activities.
  
4. Provides assistance and facilitates communications to sales/customer services management team.
  
5. Participates in bi-weekly and monthly sales/marketing meetings.
  
6. Performs related duties as directed.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  

1. Possession of a valid Life/Accident / Health Insurance Agent License issued by the
  
New York State Insurance Department; and
  
2. Possession of a High School diploma or evidence of having satisfactorily passed a
  
High School Equivalency Program; and,
  
3. Satisfactory completion of training and orientation administered by MHP personnel;
  
and,
  
4. One year of experience in direct consumer contact, sales and/or social services; or,
  
5. A satisfactory equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  
However, all incumbents must possess the required licensure as described in one
  
above.
  
6. Knowledge of a second language may be required.
  
  
For appointment to Level II:
  
1. One year of experience in Assignment Level I or one additional year of experience as
  
described above.
  
  
For appointment to Level III:
  
1. One year of experience in Assignment Level II or two additional years of experience
  
as described above.
  
  
Special Notes:
  
Possession of a valid Life/Accident / Health Insurance Agent License issued by the
  
New York State Insurance Department must be maintained in order to remain in this
  
position. Possession of a valid New York State Drivers License may be required.
  
The use of this position is restricted to MetroPlus only.

**Benefits**
------------

  

NYC Health and Hospitals offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

* Comprehensive Health Benefits for employees hired to work 20+ hrs. per week
* Retirement Savings and Pension Plans
* Paid Holidays and Vacation in accordance with employees' Collectively bargained contracts
* Loan Forgiveness Programs for eligible employees
* College tuition discounts and professional development opportunities
* College Savings Program
* Union Benefits for eligible titles
* Multiple employee discounts programs
* Commuter Benefits Programs

**How To Apply**
----------------

  

If you wish to apply for this position, please apply online by clicking the "Apply for Job" button.

DLT Air, a division of D.L. Thurrott, specializes in delivering complete compressed air solutions for industrial facilities across New England. Job Description:

**Summary**

The Outside Sales Representative is responsible for driving profitable growth within an assigned territory by selling compressed air equipment, air treatment products, nitrogen generation systems, and service agreements. This role requires strong technical aptitude, a consultative selling approach, and the ability to partner with customers across industrial environments. The representative will identify opportunities, develop engineered solutions, and ensure long-term customer satisfaction while meeting or exceeding sales targets.

**Qualifications**

* 2–5+ years of outside sales experience in industrial equipment, compressed air systems, HVAC, mechanical systems, or similar technical fields.
* Strong mechanical aptitude with the ability to learn complex systems.
* Proven record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to interpret technical data such as CFM requirements, PSI, dew point, and energy usage.
* Proficiency in CRM software.
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel frequently within the territory.

new_jobs.title: Inside Sales Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**ESSENTIAL PURPOSE OF THIS POSITION**

The Inside Sales Account Manager serves as the primary inside-sales contact for assigned customers and supports Regional Sales Managers throughout the end-to-end Quote-to-Cash process. The role drives revenue growth, customer retention, and operational efficiency by identifying sales and upsell opportunities, interpreting technical requirements, managing pricing and quotations, coordinating follow-up, resolving issues, supporting training, and managing customer projects. In the wire and cable manufacturing industry, where product complexity, lead times, and customer specifications are critical, the Inside Sales Account Manager uses CRM data and a consultative approach to anticipate customer needs, coordinate internal resources, fulfill commitments, and build strong relationships at all organizational levels.

Success in this position is measured through profitable revenue growth, customer retention, quotation responsiveness, opportunity conversion, CRM data quality, timely issue resolution, and effective coordination with sales and cross-functional partners.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Reporting to the Sales Operations Manager, the Inside Sales Account Manager owns inside-sales responsibilities for assigned key accounts. These accounts may have a history of generating significant revenue, demonstrate strong revenue potential, or hold strategic importance to the business.

* Develop account-penetration strategies for assigned target and competitive accounts to retain and expand existing business, win new business, and maintain a balanced sales opportunity funnel.
* Analyze and prepare bids and requests for quotation in accordance with established guidelines. Evaluate inventory availability, market intelligence, competitive position, price validity, logistics, and fulfillment requirements. Partner with the Business Value Manager to support pricing decisions that maximize profitability, market share, and customer value.
* Maintain an accurate opportunity funnel, complete timely follow-up to advance and close opportunities, and analyze win-loss results to identify trends and improve future sales activity.
* Maintain complete and timely records of customer interactions, quotations, and follow-up activities in HubSpot CRM. Monitor deal stages, create and complete tasks, and manage pipelines to support consistent customer engagement and accurate reporting. Identify CRM workflow or automation improvements that strengthen visibility and follow-up.
* Serve as the primary customer contact for pricing, product recommendations, policy application, sample requests, inventory availability, lead times, order status, and value-added support. Coordinate with internal subject-matter experts as needed.
* Provide responsive support before, during, and after the sale. Monitor order fulfillment, identify service risks, and coordinate resolution of nonconformances and other customer issues with the appropriate internal teams.
* Build and maintain product, application, and industry knowledge; translate product features and benefits into solutions aligned with customer needs; and participate in relevant product and sales training.
* Manage manufacturer representatives within the assigned territory by establishing communication routines, providing product and process training, supporting account activity, and monitoring follow-through.
* Contribute customer, market, pipeline, and competitive insights to territory business planning, and participate in trade shows, customer visits, and sales meetings with manufacturer representatives or Regional Sales Managers as requested.
* Respond to customer inquiries accurately, promptly, and professionally. When an immediate resolution is not available, communicate status, ownership, and next steps to internal and external stakeholders.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or marketing discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* At least two years of inside sales, account management, or direct customer-selling experience, preferably in an industrial or business-to-business manufacturing environment. Experience should include opportunity development, consultative selling, negotiation, follow-up, and closing sales.
* At least one year of experience using HubSpot, Salesforce, or an equivalent CRM to support sales operations in a manufacturing or industrial business-to-business environment.

**PREFERRED LICENSES OR CERTIFICATIONS**

* Preferred certifications include HubSpot Sales Software, Marketing Software, CRM Implementation, or comparable CRM credentials.

**SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED**

* Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing customer and business needs, make sound independent judgments within established guidelines, and escalate decisions when appropriate.
* Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build productive relationships with customers, manufacturer representatives, and internal partners at all organizational levels.
* Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret CRM data, identify sales and customer-retention trends, and recommend actions based on the findings.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Pricing, Planning, Manufacturing, Logistics, Finance, and Customer Service to move quotations, orders, and customer issues to resolution.
* Working knowledge of the requirements and challenges of manufacturer representatives, utilities, electrical distributors, engineers, and end users.
* Ability to develop working knowledge of the electrical industry, the company’s product portfolio, and the applications and customer requirements relevant to assigned accounts.

**COMPETENCIES REQUIRED**

*
